jobs.title: Day Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**In-Custody Day Program Coordinator**

The Gemma Project is seeking skilled, passionate, and dedicated individuals eager to contribute to our mission of providingand promoting the national creation of gender-responsive jail reentry programming for incarcerated and formerly incarcerated women. The Gemma Project is a trauma responsive, female-led organization that centers integrity and compassion in all the services we provide. Join our team to help us to reduce recidivism, break the intergenerational cycle of incarceration, and create healthier communities.

​​Individuals with a history of justice system involvement are strongly encouraged to apply*.*

**Physical Requirements:**

This position requires approximately 50% of work hours within in-custody jail settings and access to sensitive and protected data and therefore requires but is not limited to completion of Live Scan fingerprinting, and Tuberculosis testing prior to hire and ability *to* abide by all in-custody rules as it relates to attire, personal belongings, materials, conduct, and use of sensitive data.

**How you'll fit in:**

You’ll be a great fit for our team if you are highly skilled, compassionate, and dedicated to providing direct-service reentry programming in an in-custody setting to justice involved women. The Day Program Coordinator works to build rapport and trusting relationships with participants in a group setting prior to release and collaborates with the Continuing Care Coordinator through intentional efforts to maintain participant engagement upon release. The Day Program Coordinator conducts all aspects of running in-custody programming including: interviews, assessments, acceptance decisions; develops, delivers and maintains a relevant, applicable and trauma-responsive curriculum; provides consistent course supervision, safety, and structure to support participants in successful program completion, demonstrates healthy professional boundaries; recruits, trains, and supervises volunteer instructors and works with them to improve and update curricula as needed; works in close collaboration with The Gemma Project Team; supervises and provides direction to the Day Program Assistant; conducts necessary outreach for program; assists in evaluation of program effectiveness; maintains program data and contributes to necessary reports; engages professionally with corrections and community partners as well as funders, donors, and model site visitors.

This position reports to the Executive Director.

**What you'll do:**

* Provide overall operations of Gemma Day Program
* Maintain and update the program curriculum and schedule
* Facilitate core components of curriculum
* Recruit, train and maintain skilled volunteer program instructors
* Support, train, and guide volunteer instructors throughout sessions
* Evaluate instructor performance and make programmatic changes when necessary
* Interview, assess and make admission decisions for all applicants
* Evaluate participant progress and provide feedback to participants as needed
* Provide support and redirection to participants as needed in and out of sessions
* Respond to and document program and participant issues in a clear and timely manner
* Supervise Day Program Assistant(s)
* Coordinate with Continuing Care Coordinator on curriculum and reentry planning to assure seamless support for participants transitioning out of custody
* Collect data to assess program effectiveness and work with Executive Director to make necessary changes based on data
* Maintain accurate and timely records and prepare and submit reports as needed
* Plan and facilitate graduation ceremonies
* Perform outreach/recruitment to encourage program participation
* Perform administrative and clerical duties necessary to the position
* Maintain facility, equipment, and materials
* Attend and actively contribute to team meetings and other organizational meetings
* Attend meetings relevant to community partnerships as needed
* Work in close collaboration with Corrections staff to maintain safety, structure and integrity of program
* Regularly communicate and coordinate with Executive Director and report any concerns
* Support related fund development activities
* Provide health and Medi-Cal outreach, information, referral, eligibility, access assistance, planning and MAA coordination activities
* Perform outreach activities related to Program as needed
* Other duties as assigned

**What you'll bring:**

* Passion for The Gemma Project’s mission and empathy for the unique challenges facing incarcerated and formerly incarcerated women
* Commitment to positively contributing to a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and trauma responsive organizational culture through self-awareness, cultural humility, and valuing others
* Dedication to supporting and celebrating female identified individuals in their healing, development, and contributions to the community
* A reputation for a high standard of honesty, integrity, and professionalism
* A curious, detail-oriented, and problem-solving mindset focused on centering gender and trauma responsive services
* The ability to create and maintain collaborative relationships across other functional areas to solve problems, and improve programs, systems, and outcomes for participants
* Receptivity to feedback and ability to ask for and accept help
* The ability to find joy in our work, contribute to optimism, and celebrate individual and team achievements
* Exceptional skill at creating and maintaining a safe, structured, supportive, and trauma-responsive learning environment for participants
* Strong group facilitation and management skills including the ability to maximize participation and engage individuals with different learning styles and abilities
* Strong oral communication skills, including the ability to diffuse and deescalate challenging situations, distill and present complex information in a concise, accessible way, and capability of delivering difficult info

jobs.title: All Programs - Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Franklin Energy is redefining the clean energy future as the only integrated provider of comprehensive solutions, combining unmatched expertise in strategic consulting, program delivery, product solutions, and design/build services. Powered by our advanced AI-driven technology platforms, we deliver seamless, tech-driven support across the entire energy service ecosystem to accelerate impactful change and ensure an unmatched customer experience. Since 1994, Franklin Energy has been a trusted partner in protecting communities and our planet, paving the way for a sustainable future for all. Learn more at www.franklinenergy.com and join us in leading the clean energy revolution.
  
  
POSITION SUMMARY
  
This position is responsible for providing support to Energy Efficiency Program Delivery team members, ensuring that information is accurate, files are maintained and continuously reviewed, and continuous communication with business contacts is provided. This position is additionally responsible for managing customer grant processing, informing energy advisors of expiring grants and applications, and assisting customers and clients.
  
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  
This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.
  

* Coordinate with Energy Advisors to ensure proper organization of files, paperwork, and data entry as well as communication to the business contacts
* Assist customers with understanding how to participate in programs, how to get project incentives, and coordinating paperwork and applications
* Maintain, update, and add entries to the program databases accurately. This may require contacting clients and trade allies
* Establish proper organization and maintain a proper project file system
* Help maintain and update additional program spreadsheets relating to project tracking and scheduling of work
* Assist trade allies and customers to ensure they have the correct information and marketing materials to promote the energy efficiency incentives
* Provide assistance with customer service, scheduling and other issues as needed
* Answer the telephone and assist with mailing materials when needed
* Follow up with customers or Trade Allies to obtain information for incomplete applications
* Review project applications and documentation to ensure completeness and adherence to program rules and requirements. Communicate incentive changes and disqualifications to customers and Trade Allies

POSITION REQUIREMENTS
  
Education and Experience
  

* High School diploma or equivalent required
* 1 – 3 years of previous office experience

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities
  
  

* Strong customer service and communication skills
* Must be able to handle a wide work variety and work in a fast-paced environment
* Must be a detail-oriented, organized, self-starter, and have an ability to prioritize workload
* Ability to identify and resolve project application issues with customers and trade allies
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, specifically Word, Excel and Outlook
* Strong data entry skills in entering information in tracking systems/databases
* Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing with customers, clients and employees
* Ability to analyze and interpret data and solve practical problems
* Committed to diversity and inclusion
* Reliable transportation

Licenses & Certifications
  

* Valid driver’s license

Travel Requirements
  

* Willingness to travel up to 5%

**Compensation & Benefits:** Franklin Energy reasonably expects the starting salary for this position to fall between $24.00 and $28.00/Per-Hour. The final offer will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, geographic location, and business needs. Franklin Energy offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits; paid time off; paid holidays; and other company-sponsored benefits and programs.
  
  
**Note:** Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.
  
The above information describes the general duties and requirements necessary to perform the principle functions of the position. This shall not be construed as a detailed description of all the duties and requirements that may be necessary in this position.
  
An Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
**Safety -Sensitive Role Addendum:**  
Because many roles at Franklin Energy involve regulatory compliance, safety responsibilities, or professional licensing requirements, it is critical that interview responses reflect the candidate’s direct knowledge and experience. Misrepresentation of technical or safety qualifications may result in immediate removal from consideration.
  
  
**Notice Regarding Automated Tools:**  
We may use automated or AI-assisted tools as part of our candidate evaluation process to assess job-related skills and qualifications. These tools are intended to support fair and consistent review and do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions. All evaluations are conducted in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws.

jobs.title: Supplier Operations Manager, Hardware Components
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

We are looking for a highly organized, execution-focused Supplier Operations Manager to serve as the primary program owner for one or more assigned hardware component suppliers. This role is accountable for end-to-end execution at the supplier level, spanning forecast management, capacity planning, data quality, and cross-functional coordination across all parts and commodities sourced from the account.

The SOM is the key liaison between Form's Global Supply Management team and assigned suppliers, partnering closely with Global Supply Managers (commodity owners), Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Finance. The SOM is the active operations resource ensuring supplier readiness, compliance, and performance as Form scales from NPI into volume production.

*Relocation assistance is available. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Own end-to-end program execution for assigned supplier account(s), covering both new product introduction (NPI) and sustaining phases.
* Serve as Form's primary operational point of contact for assigned suppliers; coordinate across all parts and commodities sourced from the account.
* Partner with Global Supply Managers to align commodity sourcing strategies with supplier-level execution plans and capacity commitments.
* Manage supplier forecast submissions, order status, and capacity reviews; drive adherence to forecast and commitment cadences.
* Own supplier-level data quality and process compliance, including lead times, order status, forecast accuracy, and standardized, high-quality reporting, including regularly refreshed Clear-To-Build (CTB) reports.
* Lead regular supplier program forums, status reviews, and executive summaries with internal stakeholders and supplier leadership.
* Coordinate supplier business reviews (SBRs) and periodic performance assessments; track and escalate supplier-specific risks, shortages, and recovery plans.
* Partner with Engineering and Quality to support first article, change management (ECOs), and supplier corrective actions.
* Coordinate inbound logistics, expedites, and delivery performance with suppliers and internal planning/receiving teams.
* Onboard and train suppliers on Form's data systems, quality reporting, forecast processes, and program requirements.
* Drive resolution of cross-commodity supplier issues that span multiple internal owners.

### **What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field, with 1–3 years of experience in supply chain operations, supplier management, or manufacturing; or a recent college graduate with internship experience in a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated actions toward becoming a supply chain professional (e.g., coursework, APICS/ASCM or similar certification, relevant projects, or hands-on supply chain experience).
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional programs with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to travel up to 50% to supplier sites.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills; ability to translate between internal teams and supplier planning organizations.
* Experience with hardware supply chain operations, including forecast management, capacity planning, and supplier performance tracking.
* Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems and Excel or equivalent data tools.

### **Preferred:**

* Master's degree
* Exposure to supplier operations, material planning, or manufacturing of mechanical, plastic, metal, or electromechanical components.
* Familiarity with capacity planning and forecast / response-to-forecast processes.
* Experience coordinating across commodity managers and engineering in a matrixed organization.
* Comfort working with overseas suppliers across time zones; additional languages a plus.

jobs.title: Call Center Manager
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Profit sharing
* Vision insurance
* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance

**Call Center Manager**

**Benjamin Franklin Plumbing — Novato, CA**  
Full-time · Non-exempt hourly · On-site  
**Pay: $32 – $35 per hour**  
**Benefits:** medical, dental, vision, paid time off, paid sick leave, 401(k)

**About us**

Benjamin Franklin Plumbing is “The Punctual Plumber.” We are a locally owned residential plumbing company serving the Bay Area from our San Jose and Novato locations. Our call center is the first voice our customers hear, and it sets the tone for every job we run. We are looking for a hands-on leader to run that team.

**About the role**

The Call Center Manager leads our customer service representatives and dispatchers. You will own how calls are answered, how jobs are booked, and how the board is run every day in ServiceTitan. You will coach the team, track the numbers, and work closely with our Operations Managers to keep technicians’ days full and customers informed.

**What you will do**

* Lead, schedule, and coach a team of customer service reps and dispatchers, including weekday and weekend coverage.
* Own daily call center performance: answer rate, booking rate, abandoned calls, hold time, and call quality.
* Manage booking, scheduling, and dispatch in ServiceTitan; keep the dispatch board accurate and up to date.
* Listen to recorded calls, score them, and give regular one-on-one coaching.
* Train new hires on our call scripts, ServiceTitan workflows, and customer service standards.
* Build and maintain call scripts (inbound, outbound, follow-up and membership calls).
* Run outbound campaigns: unsold estimates, membership renewals, maintenance reminders, and follow-up calls.
* Handle escalated customer calls and complaints, and route issues to the right Operations Manager.
* Pull and report on call center KPIs from ServiceTitan weekly for leadership.
* Work with Operations and Marketing on capacity, call volume, and lead tracking.

**What you need (required)**

* **Call center experience** — 5+ years working in a call center, contact center, or customer service/dispatch team, including at least [3] year(s) in a supervisor, lead, or manager role.
* **ServiceTitan experience** — hands-on, day-to-day use of ServiceTitan, including booking calls, managing the dispatch board, and running reports.
* Proven ability to coach and hold a team accountable to call and booking metrics.
* Strong phone presence and clear written communication.
* Comfortable with computers, multiple screens, and phone systems.
* Available to work on-site at our Novato location, with flexibility for occasional early, late, or weekend coverage.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in home services (plumbing, HVAC, electrical, restoration) or another trades business.
* Experience with membership or service-agreement programs.
* ServiceTitan reporting, dashboards, or admin-level setup.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

*Each franchise location is independently owned and operated by a franchisee. Your application will go directly to the franchisee, and all hiring decisions will be made by the management of this franchisee. The franchisee sets their own compensation and benefits. All inquiries about employment, benefits, scheduling and compensation at this franchise should be made directly to the franchise location, and not to Benjamin Franklin Plumbing Corporate.*

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Before you apply: a Loom video of five minutes or less is required. Applications without one will not be reviewed.**

Mighty Fine Apps is hiring an Operations Manager to run the business side of a small, profitable company, with room to grow into Chief of Staff. You'll work directly with the founder on Live Transcribe, a live-captioning app for people who are d/Deaf and hard of hearing.

* **Reports to:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** In person in Oakland, CA
* **Structure:** Full-time, W-2 employee
* **Pay:** $110K to $135K plus benefits, depending on experience
* **Tools:** Claude and other AI tools, Notion, Google Workspace, QuickBooks

About Mighty Fine Apps

We're a small, independent company building accessibility software that people rely on every day. Founded in 2020, we're profitable and funded entirely by our customers.

Our flagship app, Live Transcribe, turns speech into accurate, real-time captions, even in noisy places like restaurants. It helps people who are d/Deaf and hard of hearing participate in conversations with family, friends, colleagues, and healthcare providers. It supports more than 50 languages, works offline, and lets users save and export transcripts.

* 20,000+ paying customers
* 15 million+ conversations captioned
* 100 million+ minutes transcribed
* 10,000+ App Store reviews at 4.6 stars

The job in 2 sentences

You're a completionist at heart: you take ownership, close every loop, and make sure the important things get finished without someone chasing you. You instinctively simplify and automate repetitive work, starting with what actually matters.

What you'll own

* **Finance and company admin.** Coordinate our bookkeeper, fractional CFO, and accountant. Manage invoices, payments, renewals, and tax deadlines, and keep the monthly close moving.
* **Hiring and onboarding.** Run hiring operations with our recruiter, from candidate pipelines and scheduling through offers, contractor agreements, and onboarding.
* **Vendors and legal.** Research providers, manage contracts and subscriptions, coordinate legal advisers, and follow through on signatures and commitments.
* **Priorities and follow-through.** Keep founder and company priorities visible. Run our meeting cadence, goal tracking, and reporting. Make sure commitments have owners and dates, follow up when work is stuck, and flag what needs a decision.
* **Systems and documentation.** Do the work yourself, understand it, then simplify or automate what deserves repeating. Build practical AI workflows and simple skills or agents, and leave clear checklists and documentation.
* **Founder support and research.** Manage calendar, meeting prep, and occasional personal logistics such as appointments and travel. Investigate ambiguous operational needs, compare tradeoffs, recommend a solution, and carry it through.

As you make routine operations run more efficiently, you'll create room for larger projects across customer support, sales, marketing, product, and company operations.

What success looks like

* **By 60 days:** You own finance, hiring, and vendor admin end to end. Deadlines and commitments are tracked, and recurring work has clear processes.
* **By 90 days:** Most routine operations run without the founder's involvement. Your improvements and automations save time and reduce follow-up.
* **By 12 months:** You lead cross-team projects and are growing toward Chief of Staff or senior operations scope as you create capacity and take on responsibility.

  
**Requirements**  
  
Who we're looking for

* **An experienced, reliable operator.** You have 4+ years in operations at a startup or small company, perhaps as an early ops hire, Chief of Staff, or EA who grew into operations. You can juggle moving pieces and take responsibility for loose ends through completion.
* **Good judgment about priorities.** You figure out what matters, what can wait, and what can be ignored before building a system. You protect the founder's time, push back on low-value work, and know when to make a decision or ask for input.
* **An AI builder.** You use AI tools every day and have personally built at least one automation that replaced recurring manual work. You can create and maintain lightweight workflows, skills, or agents.
* **A resourceful researcher.** You can turn a rough request into a recommendation and a finished result. You're comfortable comparing options, learning unfamiliar tools, and stepping into different parts of the business.
* **A hands-on approach.** You're happy to handle routine admin personally and improve it as you go. You write clear processes that someone else can understand and use.
* **Discretion.** You handle financials, contracts, and personnel matters carefully and respect confidentiality.

If automating the crap out of repetitive admin makes you smile, you'll probably like this job.

How to apply

Apply through the application form with your resume, LinkedIn, location, availability to start, and a **required Loom video of five minutes or less**.

**The Loom is not optional. Applications without a Loom link will not be reviewed.**

In your Loom, show us **one automation you personally built and used**:

* What recurring task did you automate, and why was it worth automating?
* Show what you built and explain your contribution.
* When did you put it into use, and what improved?

Use dummy data or a sanitized copy if the original contains confidential information. Make sure your video link opens without a login.

If it looks like a fit, we'll invite you to a conversation about your work, including an ambiguous assignment you took from the first request through to completion.

Our target is to hire by November 14, 2026.

 **Benefits**  

* $110,000 to $135,000 annual salary, depending on experience
* Full-time W-2 role with benefits
* Direct work with the founder of a profitable, customer-funded company
* A clear path to Chief of Staff as you create capacity and take on responsibility

**Description**
---------------

**THIS JOB DESCRIPTION IS UNDER REVIEW AND WILL BE PRESENTED TO THE PERSONNEL COMMISSION ON OCTOBER 21, 2026.**

Under the direction of the Coordinator of Operations and Emergency Preparedness or assigned administrator, plans, organizes, coordinates, supervises, and evaluates the evening, night, weekend, and after-hours operational programs of the Maintenance and Operations Department. **DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS**

* Principles and practices of effective shift supervision, workload scheduling, and staff development.

* District Merit System rules, human resources policies, and collective bargaining agreement provisions governing classified personnel.
* Applicable federal, state, and local safety regulations, including Cal/OSHA, fire codes, and building security protocols.
* Facility permit management, civic center usage procedures, and event logistical coordination.
* Energy management setback procedures and automated building system operations.

* Plan, organize, schedule, supervise, and evaluate the work of evening, night, and weekend operational personnel across multiple District sites.
* Exercise sound independent judgment and administrative discretion in resolving after-hours operational conflicts, security alarms, and emergencies.
* Apply labor contracts and Merit System rules constructively in managing performance, grievances, and shift assignments.
* Conduct thorough site quality audits and verify client compliance with facility permit agreements.
* Communicate clearly and effectively, both orally and in writing, with site administrators, staff, vendors, and community groups.
* Maintain flexible work hours, including evenings, nights, weekends, holidays, and on-call emergency response duty.
* Be flexible to perform work within changing priorities and possess sufficient interpersonal skills to work harmoniously with staff, students, administrators, parents, community members and others.

jobs.title: Assistant Operations Manager (Healthcare Administration) Concierge Primary Care
jobs.description:

**Schedule:** Full-time, Monday–Friday, 40 hours per week, excluding lunch, during traditional business hours.

**Compensation:** Nonexempt $41.63-$45.09/hour based on experience (Roughly $86,590-$93,787/year)

**Who are we?**

Private Medical has spent the last 20 years creating a new category of concierge medicine — *private medicine* — by designing a system that honors the relationship between patients, physicians, and each member of the care team. Based in California, New York, and Florida, our physician-led teams work in concert with our Gynecologists, Naturopathic Medicine Doctors, curated local specialists, elite medical centers, and specialists around the world, to provide relationship focused, evidence-based, longitudinal care to our members and their families. jobs.title: Program Manager, Accounting Operations & Strategy
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic is seeking a Program Manager to join our Accounting organization and help it run as one global team. Accounting is scaling at an unprecedented pace across multiple hubs, and the goals, rhythms, programs, and people that make up the team need to stay connected as we grow. In this role, you will own that connective tissue: the annual goal-setting cycle, the leadership team’s operating cadence, org-wide events and internal communications, and the programs that make a distributed team feel like one.

You will partner with Accounting leadership, the People team, Finance Systems, and hub leads. This is a hands-on role with a lot of range: part chief of staff, part program manager, part culture builder.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Goals and operating rhythm**

* Run the annual goal setting process and the reporting that tracks progress against those goals.
* Look at how the org actually operates (meetings, handoffs, planning cycles, decision making) and fix what isn't working.
* Maintain one org-wide planning calendar that shows close, audit, and team milestones alongside company-wide and team events, so leaders can see the pressure points and plan around them.
* Build and maintain a simple set of org health metrics (attrition, engagement scores, hiring pipeline, training completion, survey trends) and report on them regularly.

### **Leadership and org-wide events**

* Run our extended leadership team (XLT) program, including agendas, meetings, follow-ups, and action items.
* Own planning and agenda for the annual offsite and run the quarterly team all-hands.
* Write the internal updates: a regular team newsletter, plus talking points when leadership needs to explain a change to the whole org.

### **People and culture**

* Coordinate projects across the org that support employee experience programs.
* Partner with the People team to roll out training and development programs for Accounting.
* Review team survey results, identify the themes, and build action plans to address the feedback. Follow through and report back to the team.
* Run hub programs, including visit and rotation programs, local hub events, and meeting norms that work across time zones, so we feel like one global team.
* Run recognition and team rituals: wins, milestones, anniversaries, and peer recognition, especially across hubs.

### **Team operations**

* Support contractor management, including onboarding, tracking, and coordination with the right partners.
* Keep the team's knowledge base current: wiki, org charts, role descriptions, and key process docs.
* Keep the team calendar accurate so everyone knows what's coming.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* 7+ years in program management, operations, chief of staff, or strategy roles. Experience inside a finance or accounting org is a plus, but not required.
* A track record of running recurring programs end to end and getting people to follow through without formal authority.
* Good judgment about what matters and what doesn't. You can handle a lot of moving pieces without dropping them.
* Clear, direct writing. You can brief a senior leader in a few sentences.
* Comfort with confidential information and sensitive people topics.
* Experience supporting distributed or global teams.
* You're organized, but you also know when a process is getting in the way and should be simplified.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$230,000 - $300,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains.

jobs.title: Program Lead, Airports & Venues CX
jobs.description:
**About the role**  
  
Airports and venues are Uber's highest-stakes customer experience moments. Airports alone account for approximately 15% of Uber's Mobility Gross Bookings globally - a disproportionate share driven by our premium portfolio, high-value riders, and the structural complexity of airport operations across 100+ priority hubs worldwide. On a platform completing more than 40 million trips every day, airport journeys punch well above their weight: they disproportionately shape how business travelers, tourists, and premium users perceive Uber. A single poor experience at a priority hub doesn't just generate a support ticket; it drives churn among the cohort most likely to be first-trip riders, most likely to upgrade to premium products, and most likely to become long-term brand advocates.
  
  
The Airports & Venues CX program owns the global strategy to eliminate that friction at scale. We sit at the intersection of Ops, Product, and CX - translating on-the-ground airport complexity (staging lots, regulatory constraints, fare structures, matching algorithms, wayfinding failures) into systemic, data-driven solutions that reduce defects across the top 100+ priority airports worldwide including venues.
  
  
As **Program Lead, Airports & Venues CX** , you will own the global defect reduction program - the most consequential initiative within this domain. You are the person who understands what is driving each basis point of airport defect rates across key issues such as fare disputes, cancellations, lost items or transaction issues at our priority hubs, and builds the cross-functional machine that surfaces customer insights, quantifies root causes drives and advocates for product and on ground improvements to bring that number down - structurally, not episodically.
  
  
This role is ideal for a senior CX, support operations, product operations, or travel operations leader who combines analytical rigor, customer empathy, AI fluency, and deep comfort operating in complex physical environments such as airports, airlines, mobility platforms, hospitality, logistics, or large-scale venues.
  
  
**What you'll do**  
  
**Own the global airport defect reduction program end-to-end.** You will use AI to transform how we detect, diagnose, prevent, and resolve airport CX defects/painful experiences.

* Define and maintain the global defect taxonomy for Airports & Venues - classifying root causes across top issues be it fare disputes or cancellations or lost items across the top priority airports and venues.
* Build and run the global issue tracker: a systematically maintained, owner-assigned, SLA-tracked view of open defects across priority airports - published periodically to global and regional leadership.
* Lead root-cause elimination: move beyond ticket-level fixes to identify structural product, policy, and operational changes that prevent defect categories from recurring. Propose and advocate for product improvements to fix painful experiences upstream.
* Establish defect baselines and reduction targets across the top airports and venues in collaboration with Rider and Driver CX and Ops; and track and present progress periodically and systematically to senior stakeholders.

**Architect and operate the actionable intelligence infrastructure**

* Define the KPIs, parameters, and alerting thresholds to surface emerging friction patterns before they compound.
* Design and own the monthly Global Airport VOC Report - synthesizing rider and driver voice-of-customer signals across EMEA, US&C, LATAM, and APAC into prioritized, actionable insights shared with Ops and Product partners.
* Build real-time, AI generated actionable intelligence that surface which airports are trending in the wrong direction, why, and who owns the resolution. Translate intelligence into targeted VoC packages for Ops partners to drive actionable improvements

**Drive product and tech partnership for structural gap elimination**

* Serve as the primary CX advocate to Product and Engineering for airport-specific improvements.
* Co-own the experimentation roadmap with Product teams: define hypotheses, specify success metrics (defect rate, CSAT, contact rate, refund rate), and read out results to drive feature prioritization.
* Partner downstream with CX tech teams to continually improve support experience and make it more intelligent, empathetic with high resolution quality

**Own policy design and segmentation for Airports & Venues**

* Develop differentiated support models for high-value users (HVUs) at priority hubs: white-glove SLAs, proactive outreach, and faster resolution pathways - in partnership with the broader CX segmentation and tooling teams.
* Collaborate with Rider and Driver customer experience leads to design hyper segmented support policies for priority airports and user segments.
* Lead policy pilots in key priority markets and build the framework for scaling what works globally.
* Ensure policy reflects local regulatory nuances and union-governed access constraints that directly affect fare structures and driver economics.

**Lead senior stakeholder management and influence**

* Serve as the senior interface between global CX leadership and regional execution teams across all four mega-regions. Represent Airports & Venues CX in cross-functional forums - acting as the informed, data-backed voice of CX in airport strategy discussions.
* Present program performance, defect trends, and strategic recommendations to Director and VP-level audiences - with the rigor and clarity to drive decisions, not just inform them.
* Negotiate trade-offs with Product, Ops, and BD on airport CX priorities: be the person who can make the case for why a 10-basis-point improvement in defect rate at LHR justifies a product investment.
* Publish the Global Airport Newsletter (monthly) to Ops and CX stakeholders - establishing the Airports & Venues team as the authoritative intelligence source on airport CX performance globa

As a **Launch Manager** you'll be the face of Navan for our most strategic Premier clients during the most critical moment of their journey — the transition from Reed & Mackay to Navan. You'll bring deep expertise in enterprise travel program management, a consultative mindset, and the ability to earn trust fast with sophisticated buyers.

You'll own the end-to-end migration experience: from discovery and data migration through go-live and early adoption — ensuring every client launches with confidence and immediately feels the Navan difference. This role is a rare opportunity to become the subject matter expert on one of our most strategic migration paths, helping to shape our playbook and influence product design.

**What You'll Do:**

**Client Advisory & Strategic Onboarding**

* **End-to-End Ownership:** Lead complex, high-touch migrations from Reed & Mackay to Navan Premier, managing all work streams, project plans, and timelines from kickoff to go-live.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders (travel managers, CFOs, procurement), maintaining high-quality communication and holding executive presence.
* **Discovery & Workflows:** Lead the discovery process to map legacy Reed & Mackay policies, workflows, preferred suppliers, reporting, and duty of care requirements into equivalent Navan solutions.
* **Pre-Engagement Support:** Identify and partner with the Sales team on pre-engagement opportunities and RFP responses.

**Technical Integration & Cross-Functional Alignment**

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, Travel Experience/Support, Consulting & Supply, and Customer Success to resolve migration-specific complexities.
* **Product Advocacy:** Translate customer pain points and system gaps into actionable feedback to influence Navan's product roadmap.
* **Issue Escalation:** Assist customers in quickly identifying potential technical risks and escalate them appropriately to ensure a seamless onboarding window.
* **Payment & Expense Expertise** is a must

**Change Management & Process Optimization**

* **Tailored Training:** Design, develop, and deliver comprehensive change management and training programs (including written/video collateral, standard operating procedures, and remote/on-site training) to drive rapid end-user adoption.
* **Playbook Development:** Capture insights from each migration to continuously optimize process efficiency, build out work instructions, and scale the Navan Premier playbook.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 4+ years in enterprise SaaS implementation, account management, project management, or corporate travel program management.
* Deep familiarity with corporate travel programs, including policy configuration, traveler profiles, approval workflows, reporting, and duty of care.
* Direct experience implementing or administering expense programs and/or corporate card programs.
* Understanding of month-end close processes, ideally with cloud-based ERPs (e.g., NetSuite, Sage Intact, QuickBooks Online).
* A hyper-effective project manager who can dive into the weeds of complex data migration while remaining connected to macro business strategies.
* A natural, inquisitive problem solver who uncovers solutions to suit client needs. .
* Exceptional oral, written, and presentation skills; an ability to capture attention and explain complex technical concepts simply to diverse audiences.
* Experience with Salesforce, Jira, or similar project management and CRM platforms is a plus.
* Willing and able to travel both domestically and internationally to visit customers and prospects. 25%

jobs.title: Complex Strategic Program Manager
jobs.description:
Complex Strategic Program ManagerThis role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**Role Description**

The **Complex Program Manager (CPM)** is a key leadership role within HPE’s Private Cloud and Flex Solutions business, responsible for delivering large-scale, multi-site private cloud solutions as a single integrated program. In this role, you will coordinate multiple HPE technologies, including compute, storage, networking, and software, alongside Deployment Services, Professional Services, Managed Services, Local PMOs, third-party partners, and customer teams to achieve successful business outcomes.

The CPM engages early in the sales lifecycle as part of the Center of Excellence pursuit team, helping ensure solutions are deliverable as sold. From initial order and factory build (Day 0), through deployment (Day 1), migration activities (Day 2), and transition into Managed Services operations (Day M), you will provide end-to-end program leadership. This highly visible role requires strong governance, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive alignment across diverse stakeholders while delivering some of HPE’s most innovative and complex solutions.

Success in this position requires a combination of program management expertise, technical acumen, relationship management, cross-functional leadership, and meticulous attention to detail.

**What Makes This Role Complex**

The CPM leads programs that integrate multiple HPE products into a single customer solution, while direct ownership of those products remains with separate business units. Networking, compute, storage, and software offerings each follow independent roadmaps and release cycles. Program delivery responsibilities are distributed across the CPMO, Local PMOs, Engineering, Managed Services, partners, and customer teams. The CPM is accountable for driving alignment, managing dependencies, resolving issues, escalating risks, and leading recovery efforts whenever program outcomes are at risk.

**Responsibilities**

**Value Chain Alignment**

* Align Sales, the Center of Excellence, Business Unit Engineering, Supply Chain, Services, Local PMOs, and partner organizations around a single integrated delivery plan, beginning in pre-sales to ensure solutions are deliverable as sold.
* Lead structured handoff and transition reviews at each major program phase (pursuit to order, factory to site, deployment to operations), ensuring documented entry and exit criteria are met.

**End-to-End Schedule Management**

* Own and maintain the integrated master schedule from order through delivery and execution, ensuring alignment with product release timelines, material availability, dependencies, and critical path activities.
* Oversee end-to-end execution across factory build, deployment, migration waves, cutovers, rollback planning, and hypercare activities, coordinating Local PMOs, Deployment Services, Engineering, and customer teams.

**Operating Model**

* Lead stakeholder engagement, governance, and go/no-go readiness reviews throughout the program lifecycle.
* Ensure customer communications are consistent, coordinated, and delivered through agreed governance channels.

**Escalation Management**

* Identify and communicate issues early, including business impact assessments and recovery plans.
* Partner with CPMO leadership and executive sponsors to address risks and issues before escalation to customers or partners becomes necessary.

**Risk and Change Management**

* Maintain a comprehensive RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) log as the program’s single source of truth, ensuring every item has a defined owner, mitigation strategy, and target completion date.
* Drive formal change control processes for scope, schedule, and cost impacts.
* Assess troubled or at-risk programs, identify root causes, develop recovery strategies, and restore execution health and stakeholder confidence.

**Skills**

* **Communication:** Delivers clear, concise, and transparent status updates; proactively communicates challenges along with actionable recovery plans.
* **Ownership:** Takes accountability for overall program outcomes, even when delivery responsibilities are distributed across multiple teams and organizations.
* **Critical Thinking:** Evaluates assumptions, identifies cross-functional dependencies, anticipates risks, and proactively addresses potential issues.
* **Leadership:** Influences decisions and drives alignment across teams and stakeholders without direct authority; escalates strategically when required.

**Education and Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* 10+ years of experience leading complex global infrastructure programs, including data center and/or private cloud implementations, in geographically distributed environments.
* Working knowledge of compute, enterprise storage, networking technologies, and private cloud or virtualization operating models.
* Demonstrated success assessing, stabilizing, and recovering troubled or at-risk programs.
* Extensive program management expe

itD is seeking a **Project Coordinator III** to support budget planning, forecasting, spend governance, accruals, and reporting within a leading technology company's Hardware Devices organization. The ideal candidate will bring 5+ years of experience in financial operations, spend analysis, budgeting, and forecasting, with practical expertise in AI-driven workflow automation and a proven track record of delivering actionable financial insights to directors and senior leadership.

**Location:** Hybrid — Sunnyvale, CA (3 days per week onsite).

**Duration:** 12 months

**Pay Rate:** $60 - $65 per hour.

We provide comprehensive medical benefits, a 401(k) plan, paid holidays, and more.

Please note that we are only considering direct W2 candidates at this time, as we are unable to offer sponsorship.

**Responsibilities**

* Support quarterly and annual budget planning and forecasting cycles by guiding engineering teams through processes, resolving inquiries, and ensuring timely submissions.
* Analyze budget, forecast, and actual spend data to identify variances, explain underlying drivers, and recommend opportunities to optimize spending.
* Audit budget and forecast submissions to ensure financial data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across engineering teams.
* Manage monthly accrual cycles by collecting and validating accruals against open purchase order balances and goods or services received, ensuring timely and accurate submissions.
* Develop and maintain recurring reports and dashboards covering budget status, forecasts, commitments, vendors, purchase orders, and financial performance for leadership.

* Build out material to contribute to the Digital Transformation practice.
* Attend internal itD networking events, both in person and virtually.
* Work with leadership on career fast-track opportunities.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Advanced spreadsheet skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and large-workbook modeling.

* Experience with New Product Introduction (NPI) processes and product development lifecycle milestones.
* Previous experience at major technology or product companies such as Apple, Google, or Microsoft.
* Experience implementing process improvements, change management initiatives, and new business workflows.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
* Relevant professional experience or certifications in data analytics, Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, SQL, or cloud-based data analytics.

**Education**

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field is preferred but not required. Equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.

jobs.description:
Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Archer is a leader in the next-gen aerospace sector building an end-to-end advanced air mobility platform that delivers air taxis, unmanned aircraft systems ("UAS"), aviation-related physical artificial intelligence ("AI") solutions, and other technologies to customers worldwide across the commercial aerospace and defense sectors.

Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. We are dedicated to cultivating an equitable and inclusive environment that embraces our differences, and supports and celebrates all of our team members.

Archer is best known for Midnight, our electric aircraft. This role isn't on that program. The AI Products Org builds consumer software for the general aviation industry. There's a lot we're not ready to talk about publicly yet, so this posting stays vague on purpose. What we can say: the products are real, they ship, and people use them every day.  
  
As the Deployment Operations Coordinator, you'll identify, research, and secure host locations near airports for Vantage receiver installations. You'll be the first point of contact with prospective host businesses — researching candidate sites, cold-calling and emailing property owners and operators, and negotiating hosting agreements — then handing off clean, well-documented sites to the Deployment Engineering team for installation. You'll also assist with the backend administrative work that keeps the pipeline moving: tracking outreach, processing agreements and paperwork, and coordinating scheduling between hosts and the field team.

This role involves equal parts research, phone/email outreach, and the follow-through to keep every site moving from first contact to signed agreement to install-ready.

### **Research & Outreach:**

* Identify candidate businesses near target airports suitable for hosting Vantage receivers (rooftop access, line-of-sight, power availability, etc.)
* Build and maintain a pipeline of prospective host sites, researching ownership, decision-makers, and site suitability before outreach
* Cold-call and email property/business owners to pitch hosting the equipment, answer questions, and move interested parties toward an agreement
* Track outreach activity, responses, and pipeline status in a CRM or tracking system

### **Site Agreements & Backend Operations:**

* Draft, send, and track hosting agreements and related paperwork through signature
* Maintain accurate records for each site: contact info, agreement status, site specs, and any special access/logistics notes
* Coordinate scheduling and handoff of signed, install-ready sites to the Deployment Engineering team
* Support general program administration — reporting on pipeline metrics, maintaining site databases, and flagging bottlenecks

### **Coordination:**

* Act as liaison between host businesses and Archer's field team before and after install (initial site walk questions, access coordination, follow-up)
* Communicate professionally and persistently with businesses that may be unfamiliar with the technology or hesitant to host equipment

  

About The Team:  
AI Products is a roughly 100-person software org inside a company of aerospace engineers, and we expect to grow substantially over the next year. jobs.title: Patient Success & Growth Coordinator
jobs.description:
Patient Success & Growth Coordinator (Pinnacle Wellness Center)

**Patient Success & Growth Coordinator**Pinnacle Wellness Center (Suen Chiropractic) | Pleasanton, CAPart-Time, Weekday Mornings (9am-12pm)

**ABOUT US**

For six years, Pinnacle Wellness Center has been built around a different approach to care. Our lead provider, Dr. Ryan Suen, is a chiropractor who specializes in Applied Kinesiology – using it to find the actual root of what's going on with a patient, instead of running a high-volume adjustment mill. We pair this care with hyperbaric oxygen therapy (HBOT) to support the whole picture of our patient’s health. We're growing into a broader wellness center over the next few years, and we're looking for the right person to help us build it.

**THE ROLE**

This is a part-time, Monday through Friday morning position. This person will be the consistent face and voice our patients see from their first conversation with our marketing team all the way through their ongoing care with us. They will pick up where our marketing team leaves off with new patients who've already booked their first visit, run our HBOT chamber sessions, staff the front desk for morning patients, and convert first-time visitors into ongoing patients.

**YOUR TIME, ROUGHLY BROKEN DOWN**

Sales & Patient Conversion (~40%)

* Reach out to new patients after they've booked, to confirm their visit, answer questions, and set expectations for their first appointment including what to bring and wear (comfortable clothing, water, recommendations on what they can do while using the HBOT like reading a book)
* Follow up after a patient's first HBOT/chiro visit to talk through how it went and what's next
* Walk patients through care package and membership options: pricing, payment plans, and answering questions or honest hesitations
* Process payment and enrollment when a patient decides to move forward

Operations (~35%)

* Operate our wellness-grade HBOT chamber for new and returning patients (full training provided, no certification required)
* Staff the front desk for any patient booked in the morning, new or returning

Marketing Support (~20%)

* Social media, review requests, and follow-up outreach during downtime between sessions

Systems & Process (~5%)

* Help build and refine the SOPs behind all of the above as we grow

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

Experience:

* Real sales or closing experience. You're comfortable processing transactions, closing sales, and managing the full sales cycle from start to finish. You’re well-versed in overcoming objections, ensuring a "let me think about it" never stalls the conversation but instead opens the door to a deeper conversation. This is the single most important qualification for this role.

Who You Are:

* You genuinely believe in the mission. You believe in the root-cause and relationship-based care over a high-volume mill.
* Team-oriented and collaborative, yet deeply adaptable; comfortable assessing shifting situations on your own and stepping in to handle them without waiting for direction.
* Reliable, precise follow-through; chamber operation means following the same safety procedure exactly, every time
* Proactive and forward-thinking, with a natural ability to spot small operational gaps and solve them before they become issues.
* Genuinely available Monday through Friday mornings, on an ongoing basis

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Prior experience in healthcare, wellness, or a med-spa-style patient coordinator role
* Interest in helping build SOPs and operational systems as we grow

**SCHEDULE & PAY**

Part-time, Monday through Friday, 9am–12pm shift (15 hours to start, with room to expand toward 20+ hours). Given the morning schedule and the need for reliable, in-person coverage, we're prioritizing candidates based in or near the Tri-Valley (Pleasanton, Dublin, San Ramon, and Livermore) who can consistently make it in without fighting unpredictable traffic.

$23/hour, plus a quarterly bonus tied to how well you're helping new patients follow through into ongoing care – not a per-sale commission. We want someone focused on doing right by the patient and building a real relationship, not chasing individual closes. Room to grow in hours and scope as the practice does.

**TO APPLY**

Please send your resume, a short note on why this role appeals to you, and your contact information to . Label the subject: “Interest in Patient Success & Growth Coordinator position [First and Last name].”

Pay: $22.00 - $23.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 per week

Benefits:

* Free health screenings
* Free parking
* On-the-job training
* Wellness program

Application Question(s):

* Are you legally authorized to work in the United States?
* Do you have direct experience in sales, closing deals, or helping customers commit to a purchase?
* Are you available to work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–12:00 PM (with potential to grow to 15–20 hrs/week), on an ongoing basis?
* Do you live in or near the Tri-Valley (Pleasanton, Dublin, San Ramon, Livermore), or can you reliably commute to Pleasanton for a 9:00 AM start?
* This role involves handling patient payments and having direct conversations about pricing. Are you comfortable with that?

Work Location: In person

**Organization Description**

The Miss Major Alexander L. Lee TGIJP Black Trans Cultural Center is a team of transgender, gender-variant and intersex people, inside and outside of prisons, jails, detention centers, and other locked facilities creating a united family in the struggle for survival and freedom. We work in collaboration with others to forge a culture of resistance and resilience to strengthen us for the fight against human rights abuses, imprisonment, police violence, racism, poverty, and societal pressures. We seek to create a world rooted in self-determination, freedom of expression, and gender justice.

**Position Description**

TGIJP’s Client Services Coordinators are the first to greet our clients, staff, partners, Board Members, and other community members when they come into our office. First impressions are everything when it comes to telegraphing safety, security, empowerment, trauma-informed care, and an abolitionist mindset to all we meet. You’re expected to know how to work with dozens of different kinds of people effectively, to know how to appropriately prioritize and execute administrative and operational tasks, and to be able to maintain a level of professionalism, pleasant demeanor, and grounded approach to the work.

* Supervise clients, staff, and the general public who may be waiting in lobby or front desk areas.

* Maintain cleanliness across the building, also including the front door, restrooms, and outside area around the building.
* Restock the waiting room fridge, supply closet, restrooms, and snack trays as needed.
* Refill the water cooler in the waiting room as needed.
* Take out the trash in every room in the office each day, and take out the trash that has collected in the waste bins every Wednesday night at midnight.
* Vacuum, sweep, dust, and mop the office as directed.
* Safely utilize cleaning chemicals.
* Inform leadership when repairs are needed.
* Assist with setup and takedown of TGIJP meetings and events as requested.

***5. Driving***

* Drive clients and staff to their meetings and appointments in the TGIJP van as requested, ensuring that all riders comply with the no smoking/vaping requirement.

**Working Conditions:**

This position may require occasional evening or weekend hours to accommodate client needs.

TGIJP provides all full-time staff with comprehensive medical, dental, vision, commuter, chiropractic, and acupuncture benefits, along with a generous PTO package.

jobs.title: EHS Program Leader, Hazardous Materials & Industrial Safety
jobs.description:

=======================================================

If you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and planet, this role is for you. As our EHS Program Leader for the California R&D/production site, you’ll partner with operations and engineering to design systems that meet regulatory obligations, minimize risk, and advance the business.

**Your mission**
----------------

Elevate safety culture while delivering regulatory confidence and operational results.

**The challenge**
-----------------

* Could you turn audits into opportunities? Plan and execute inspections, assessments, and risk reviews that drive measurable improvements.
* Can you navigate complexity? Maintain permits and certifications; ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, DOT, and local/state rules.
* Will you lead by example? Chair the Safety Committee and empower employees to participate actively in EHS initiatives.
* Do you think systemically? Strengthen ISO 14001/45001 management systems and support internal/external audits.
* Are you data‑driven? Investigate incidents and near‑misses using fishbone and 5‑Whys; implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Can you make work safer, faster? Conduct JHA/JSA with production/engineering; implement controls and specify PPE.
* Will you protect our environment? Manage hazardous materials and waste, including reporting, handling, and Hazardous Materials Business Plan updates.
* Can you teach what you know? Deliver targeted EHS training to employees, contractors, and visitors.
* Will you scale impact? Share best practices across sites and collaborate with HQ to align companywide EHS strategies.

----------------------------

### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (environmental sciences, OSH, industrial hygiene, etc.). A mix of education, certifications, and/or experience will be considered.
* Desired certifications: CSP, CIH, CHMM, OSHA‑30, HAZWOPER.
* 3–5+ years in a comparable EHS role; high‑volume manufacturing exposure preferred.

### **Capabilities**

* Comprehensive knowledge of OSHA/EPA/DOT and applicable state/local regulations.

**Where and how you’ll work**
-----------------------------

Full‑time, salaried‑exempt position. May require extended hours and occasional weekends to meet critical program milestones and customer requirements.

* Move fluidly between office and manufacturing environments.
* Spend time at a computer and other productivity tools while seated for extended periods.

* PPE is provided and must be used as required.
* Occasional lifting up to 40 lbs independently; over 50 lbs with help.

**Preferred strengths**
-----------------------

* Experience with ISO 9001 systems
* Leadership in Workplace Safety & EHS Management
* Comfort measuring and improving LTIR (Lost Time Injury Rate)
* ISO 14001 certification experience

jobs.title: Enablement Program Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We’re looking for an **Enablement Program Manager** to build the engine that keeps Outset’s go-to-market teams sharp, current, and ready to win.

This is a **high-ownership role reporting to the VP of Sales**, responsible for enabling our **Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Product Marketing and Solutions teams at scale**. Outset moves fast: new products, new verticals, new competitors, and new use cases land every month. Your job is to turn that change into clear, usable knowledge—and get it into the hands (and heads) of every customer-facing person on the team.

You’ll design **plug-and-play enablement programs** that new content can drop straight into: onboarding, product launches, competitive updates, certifications, and ongoing skills training. You’ll own our **GTM knowledge repository** so the right answer is always easy to find. And you’ll do it by partnering across **GTM, Product, Marketing, G&A, and Leadership**—often without a playbook, and always with a bias toward making it work.

This role is built for a **high-upside, early-career operator**: someone who has already shown they can own programs end to end, teach complex topics clearly, and thrive in ambiguity, and who wants to grow with a category-defining company.

**Responsibilities**

* Own Outset’s **GTM enablement program end to end**: roadmap, calendar, delivery, and measurement.
* Design **repeatable, plug-and-play enablement frameworks** (onboarding, launch kits, competitive updates, certifications) that new content can drop into with minimal rework.
* Build and run **new-hire onboarding** that gets new GTM team members ramped and customer-ready quickly.
* Act as a **world-class teacher**: quickly learn complex topics—AI-moderated research, research methodology, new products, pricing, competitors—then synthesize and deliver them so they stick.
* Own and maintain the **GTM knowledge repository**, keeping messaging, battlecards, playbooks, and product content accurate, organized, and easy to find.
* Partner with **Product and Marketing** to translate launches and roadmap updates into field-ready training, talk tracks, and assets.
* Partner with **Sales, CS, and Partnerships leaders** to identify skill and knowledge gaps and prioritize what gets built next.
* Work with **G&A and Leadership** on cross-functional topics—deal desk, pricing, legal, and process changes—so the field knows what changed and how to act on it.
* Run **live trainings, workshops, and certifications**, and build async content (recordings, guides, quizzes) that scales across time zones.
* Measure what works: track **ramp time, certification completion, content usage, and field feedback**, and iterate on programs accordingly.
* Bring structure to ambiguity—spot gaps no one owns and **find a way to make it work**.

**Qualifications**

* **4+ years of professional experience** in Enablement, Learning & Development, a Center of Excellence, or a Chief of Staff function.
* **Proven program ownership:** you’ve built and run programs end to end, not just contributed to them.
* **Exceptional teaching and communication skills**. You can take a complex topic, distill it, and make it land with any audience.
* You **drive adoption, not just delivery.** You treat sales as your core customer, find the early adopters, and turn their wins into peer examples and success stories that pull the rest of the team along.
* **You build learning that compounds**. You reinforce and build on what reps already know, rather than publishing materials and expecting people to “get it.”
* A track record of designing **scalable, repeatable processes** and systems that others can use without you in the room.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with experience owning a knowledge base, content library, or similar source of truth.
* Strong cross-functional partnership skills, with experience working across GTM, Product, G&A, and senior leadership.
* **Proven success in a fast-paced startup environment.** You’re comfortable with ambiguity, create structure where none exists, and adjust quickly as priorities shift.
* A high-ownership, resourceful mindset: you find a way to make it work.
* Experience supporting B2B SaaS GTM teams is a strong plus; familiarity with AI products or market research is a bonus.

Compensation Range: $130K - $175K

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**

As a Program Manager on Anthropic's Safeguards team, you'll help make sure we meet our obligations under AI safety laws and regulations around the world. Working closely with Legal, you'll turn new and emerging requirements into programs, controls, and deliverables. This requires a detailed understanding of how our models and products are built, evaluated and safeguarded.
