jobs.title: Materials and Product Lifecycle Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**

Gimlet is building the first multi-silicon neocloud designed for fast, efficient AI inference.

We combine large-scale compute infrastructure with an execution platform that partitions AI workloads and maps each stage to the hardware best suited to run it.

We work with foundation labs, hyperscalers, and AI-native companies, giving our team access to technical problems spanning frontier models, production infrastructure, and emerging hardware.

**About the role**

As the Product Lifecycle & BOM Operations Program Manager at Gimlet, you will own the lifecycle of the hardware we procure and deploy across our data centers, from new part introduction to end of life. You will create and control internal part numbers, structure top-level assembly BOMs, keep part and BOM data accurate, and translate deployment plans into material requirements.

This role is the operational bridge between Engineering, Supply Chain, and infrastructure deployment. Your focus is making sure we have the right hardware, at the right revision, at the right time.

**What you'll do:**

**Product lifecycle management**

* Own the full part lifecycle: new part introduction, active production, end of life (EOL), and obsolescence.
* Monitor manufacturer EOL notices and product change notifications (PCNs), assess their impact on active and planned deployments, and drive last-time buys or qualified replacements with Engineering.
* Manage excess and obsolete (E&O) inventory, including disposition plans that minimize cost.

**Internal part numbering and part data**

* Create internal part numbers using a consistent numbering scheme, and map each one to its manufacturer part numbers (MPNs) and approved sources.
* Define and enforce part data standards: descriptions, units of measure, revision levels, lifecycle status, and approved manufacturer and vendor lists (AML/AVL).
* Read and interpret component datasheets and spec sheets to verify key attributes, such as form factor, electrical and thermal ratings, compatibility, and compliance, before a part is released.

**BOM structure and accuracy**

* Build and maintain multi-level BOMs, from top-level assemblies (racks, servers, networking) down to sub-assemblies and components.
* Own BOM accuracy: audit BOMs regularly, reconcile them against what is purchased, received, and deployed, and resolve discrepancies quickly.
* Control BOM releases and revisions through the engineering change process (ECR/ECO), and assess each change's impact on open orders, inventory, cost, and delivery.

**Material planning**

* Translate approved deployment plans into time-phased material requirements and purchasing priorities.
* Track long-lead components, shortages, and material readiness across suppliers and sites.
* Report material risks and recommended actions to Supply Chain and deployment leaders.

**What success looks like**

In your first 3 to 6 months, you will:

* Stand up a controlled internal part numbering scheme and part register covering all active deployments.
* Build released, revision-controlled top-level assembly BOMs for our core rack, server, and networking configurations.
* Set a BOM accuracy baseline and a regular audit process, with a clear target and a plan to close the gaps.
* Put an EOL and PCN monitoring process in place for critical components, with last-time-buy or replacement plans for at-risk parts.
* Define clear handoffs with Engineering for BOM releases and engineering changes.
* Build a material-readiness view tied to deployment milestones and purchasing priorities.
* Develop practical PLM and ERP workflows so Engineering, Supply Chain, and deployment teams work from one accurate, current source of part and BOM data.

**You may be a good fit if you have**

* 5+ years of experience in product lifecycle management, BOM management, materials planning, or hardware operations.
* Hands-on experience creating internal part numbers and structuring multi-level BOMs, from top-level assemblies down to components.
* A strong understanding of revision control, engineering change processes (ECR/ECO), and AML/AVL management.
* The ability to read and interpret datasheets and spec sheets for hardware such as servers, networking gear, power, cabling, and optics.
* Experience managing EOL notices, PCNs, last-time buys, and excess and obsolete inventory.
* Experience translating changing deployment schedules into material plans, and managing long-lead components and shortages.
* Strong analytical skills, with advanced spreadsheet experience and hands-on use of PLM systems (such as Arena, Agile, or Windchill) and ERP systems (such as NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle).
* The ability to work closely with Engineering while respecting clear ownership: Engineering owns design, technical qualification, and substitutions; you own part data and BOM integrity.
* A track record of bringing structure and discipline to fast-moving hardware programs.

**Strong candidates may also have**

* Experience supporting data center, compute, networking, server, semiconductor, or other complex hardware deployments.
* Experience building a part numbering system, BOM standards, or PLM process from scratch in a fast-scaling company.
* Experience implementing, migrating, or improving PLM and ERP systems.
* Experience working across multiple suppliers, contract manufacturers or ODMs, deployment sites, and hardware configurations.
* An APICS/ASCM certification such as CPIM or CSCP.

**Why join now?**

Gimlet is expanding from its core technology into a production neocloud spanning new hardware, customers, and data centers.

* Solve hard problems.
* Own meaningful work.
* Build for production.
* Help define what’s next.

*Agency Policy:* *Gimlet Labs does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted without a signed agreement will be considered the property of Gimlet Labs, and no fees will be paid.*

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.  
  
We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.  
  
In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

**About the Role**
------------------

Factory is pioneering autonomous software development. At the heart of this mission is our GTM organization, where we are rapidly scaling a world-class sales team to bring innovative developer tools to market.

We are seeking a visionary Sales Enablement Manager to architect, lead, and independently scale our end-to-end onboarding and certification strategy. In this foundational role, you will design the strategic playbook for selling Factory from the ground up, shaping how every new seller achieves consistent productivity.

Partnering closely with leaders and teams across Factory, you will define our sales methodology and build programs that turn technical innovations into enterprise adoption. If you thrive in an early-stage environment where you can autonomously own strategic initiatives and accelerate the future of software engineering, this is your opportunity to make a defining impact.

### **What you will do and achieve**

Program Strategy & Architecture

* Drive strategy and end-to-end execution for onboarding every new seller at Factory, from day one to their first closed deal.
* Independently build and scale the program by designing the strategic playbook for selling Factory where no prior template exists.
* Shape how new sellers sell at Factory, since every one of them starts in your program.

Bootcamp & Role-Based Certification

* Design and maintain comprehensive curriculum tracks for Account Executives, Solutions Engineers, and Sales Development Representatives, covering foundational company knowledge before diving into role-specific workflows.
* Lead interactive live training sessions for bootcamp cohorts, partnering closely with subject matter experts, moderators, and sales leaders to facilitate continuous learning.
* Establish clear evaluation criteria and certification standards for each role, holding new hires accountable and continuously refining content based on cohort performance and feedback.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Management

* Partner with managers to establish and track 90-day onboarding plans, stepping in to support new hires who fall behind.
* Collaborate closely with senior sales leaders, founders, and cross-functional partners across Product, Solutions Engineering, and Revenue Operations to rapidly build out the enablement function.
* Regularly sync with sales managers, top reps, and subject matter experts to identify rep bottlenecks and deliver targeted training solutions.

Scalability, Delivery & AI Integration

* Package and scale training modules so sessions can be delivered seamlessly by managers and senior reps, supporting both local and remote sellers via live and self-paced learning.
* Maintain curriculum currency and relevance by continuously updating content as the product evolves and retiring obsolete materials.
* Leverage AI agents and automated workflows (such as Droids) to streamline program administration, update materials, and track seller readiness efficiently.

Continuous Learning & Performance Measurement

* Train experienced reps too, with launch updates, sales method refreshers at QBRs and Sales Kickoff, and focused help where we are losing deals.
* Track how long new hires take to close their first deal, how many reach quota, how they do on certification, and what changes in their calls.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Enablement Experience & Leadership: 5+ years in sales enablement focused on building, driving, and scaling end-to-end new-hire onboarding strategies from scratch.
* Instructional Design & Presentation: Deep expertise in instructional design principles, creating clear and attractive training collateral, and delivering engaging live presentations in person or virtually.
* Metrics & Execution: Highly organized and detail-oriented with a proven track record of tracking ramp metrics and optimizing enablement programs based on performance data.
* Technical Fluency & Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible training for non-technical sellers, fostering open two-way feedback.
* Startup & Preferred Background: Thrives in fast-paced early-stage environments. Experience as an AE/SE, background with dev tools, AI products, MEDDPICC/Command of the Message, or automating workflows with AI agents is strongly preferred.

**This is an in-office position (5 days/week) in San Francisco (walking distance to Caltrain)**

＄90,000 - ＄100,000 on-target earnings (OTE) per year, comprising base salary and performance-based bonus.

Do you want to help build the future of AI-driven customer success and make a real impact within a fast-growing scale-up?

We started as SEO specialists and evolved into engineers building a fully automated system for long-tail search and GEO visibility. Nova transforms repetitive SEO work into scalable, predictable growth, designed for brands that want lasting authority, not short-term wins.

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. jobs.description:
RH Outlets play a vital role in our integrated ecosystem, offering an elevated experience that redefines luxury value in the home furnishings space. With more than 40 locations across North America and Europe, our Outlets curate beautifully crafted pieces, including discontinued, returned, and slightly imperfect items, at the intersection of quality, design, and value. Our Outlets extend the life of our designs, connect our brand to a broader audience, and embody our belief that great design should be both inspiring and accessible.

  

RH is seeking an Outlet Operations Leader to develop a high-energy, results-driven stock team and ensure the seamless flow of operations. Partnering with cross-functional teams, this role drives operational excellence, safeguards inventory accuracy, and upholds the highest safety standards. The ideal candidate is a motivational leader who champions quality, inspires collaboration, and empowers teams to deliver extraordinary customer experiences.

  

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

* Train the stock team to uphold all safety protocols and inventory policies, fostering a culture of accountability and operational excellence
* Oversee the seamless receipt, processing, and transition of merchandise from truck to storage to sales floor, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and readiness for customers.

* Direct the release of product to third-party delivery partners and customers, ensuring both accuracy and exceptional service standards.
* Authorize and manage the destruction of products designated as marked out of stock (MOS) in compliance with company policies
* Ensure operational interactions with customers and delivery partners reflect company service standards

OUR REQUIREMENTS

* 2+ years of leadership experience in retail, preferably in home furnishings
* Exceptional analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills
* Proficiency with Mac operating systems, iOS devices, Microsoft Office, Google applications.

* Adaptable and resilient, with a solutions-focused approach to change and challenges

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Onos Health**

Onos Health’s mission is simple but ambitious: ensure every healthcare dollar goes toward delivering the highest quality care. Today, nearly 30% of U.S. healthcare spending is wasted due to ineffective care and administrative burden caused by misalignment between providers and payers.

Onos is addressing this by building the AI platform that enables health plans to understand clinical care at scale. By transforming unstructured clinical documentation into actionable insights, we help payers make faster, more informed decisions, identify opportunities to improve quality and reduce waste, and ensure more healthcare dollars are directed toward delivering better outcomes.

Come join a category-defining company and transform how healthcare is managed in the U.S.

**Why Onos**

Meaningful impact: Help solve one of healthcare’s biggest challenges by improving quality while reducing waste.

Ownership: Take on significant responsibility from day one and shape a rapidly growing company.

Direct collaboration: Work alongside experienced founders with deep expertise in healthcare, AI, and product development.

High-performing team: Join a transparent, collaborative, and execution-focused culture.

Build something new: Help define the next generation of AI-powered healthcare analytics.

**The Role**

Onos is growing, and our health plan customers are growing with us. As a Strategic Account Manager, you’ll be the go to person payers count on to make Onos work for them, and the person our product and operations teams count on to tell them what those payers actually need.

In this role you’ll manage real payer relationships, shape how we deliver value, and help set up the processes that let us scale without losing the personal touch.

**What you’ll own**

* Strategic payer relationships: you’re the day-to-day lead and trusted advisor for a portfolio of health plan customers
* Cross-functional partnership: you work with product and operations to make sure payers get the most out of Onos
* Voice of the customer: you bring client needs, feedback, and friction points back to the team, and push to get them addressed
* Account initiatives and project execution: you drive them from kickoff to delivery, on time and with clear owners
* Scaling the account function: you help build the processes, playbooks, and operating rhythms that support our growth across Onos
* Other duties as needed. We’re an early team, so the work will evolve.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in strategic account management, product management, or client services
* Bonus if you have 1–2 years of management consulting experience
* Direct experience with healthcare payers, whether working at a health plan or managing health plan clients as a vendor or partner
* Working knowledge of how healthcare businesses and payers operate, including the stakeholders and priorities
* Familiarity with payer data, health plan workflows, or value-based care programs
* Experience with AI-enabled products or technical SaaS platforms
* Startup or fast-paced environment experience where things aren’t defined. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, and you bring structure to it instead of waiting for it to clear up
* A proactive, forward-thinking approach to client management. You anticipate what clients will need before they ask, bring clarity when the path isn’t obvious, and act without waiting for direction
* Track record of working cross-functionally with product teams while driving projects and initiatives across the organization
* Comfort translating between client needs and internal teams, in both directions
* Experience building account management processes, playbooks, or reporting from scratch
* Strong written and verbal communication, including with senior client stakeholders

**Benefits & Perks**

* Hybrid 3x per week in office (Mon/Tues/Thurs) in San Francisco, Financial District
* Flexible vacation policy
* Paid parental leave
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* 401(k)
* Significant equity as an early employee
* Direct mentorship from experienced founders
* Ground-floor opportunity to help build both the product and company
* Regular team events and off-sites
* Company provided equipment and home office setup
* In-office lunches and snacks provided

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Onos. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic.

Compensation Range: $160K - $180K

**Training and advancement:** You will enter our Clinical Leadership Program that creates and supports a culture of continuous learning for our managers. The curriculum will cover onboarding, essential functions, leading your business, and advanced leadership. As a Facility Administrator, you may advance your career into a Director of Operations then senior leadership role.

**Our culture:** We believe our employees are our most important asset — we value, care about, and support our people. We are there when you may need us most, from tuition reimbursement to support your education goals, granting scholarships to family members, delivering relief when natural disasters strike, or providing financial support when personal hardship hits, we take care of our people.

**Our focus on diversity:** We have built a nurturing environment that welcomes every age, race, gender, sexual orientation, background, and cultural tradition. We have a diverse range of employee resource groups (ERGs) to encourage employees with similar interests, goals, social and cultural backgrounds, or experiences to come together for professional and personal development, discussion, activities, and peer support. Our diverse workforce and culture encourage opportunity, equity, and inclusion for all, which is a tremendous asset that sets us apart.

At Fresenius Medical Care, you will truly make a difference in the lives of people living with kidney disease. If this sounds like the career and company you have been looking for, and you want to be a vital part of the future of healthcare, apply today.

**PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES**

  

CLINIC OPERATIONS:

* Manages the operations of the clinic, including costs, processes, staffing, and quality standards.
* Provides leadership, coaching, and development plans for all direct reports.
* Partners with internal Human Resources, Quality, and Technical Services departments.
* Collaborates with the Home Therapies Manager to oversee the facility’s Home Therapies Program.
* Maintains integrity of medical and operations records and complies with all data collections and auditing activities.
* Manages clinic financials including efficient utilization of supplies or equipment and regular profits and loss review.
* Responsible for all required network reporting and on-site state or federal surveys.
* Coordinates inventory/supply management by reviewing monthly inventory count and approving purchase orders for necessary items to ensure cost containment, timely distribution, and competitive pricing.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

PATIENT CARE:

* Collaborates closely with the Charge RN, the Medical Director, and physicians regarding the direct patient care responsibilities within the facility.
* Coordinates all aspects of patient care from admission through discharge of the patient.
* Monitors patient and family education regarding access care including medical instructions.
* Acts as a resource for the patient and family to address concerns and questions and reviews patient satisfaction surveys.

STAFF:

* Participates in the selection and hiring of new team members and ensures completion of new hiring orientation and mandatory trainings.
* Responsible for all patient care employees completing appropriate training courses and that licensures and certifications are current.
* Provides support for all clinical staff members at regular intervals and encourages professional growth.
* Maintains current knowledge regarding company benefits, policies, procedures, and processes.
* Completes employee evaluations and establishes annual goals.
* Documents any disciplinary actions and confers with the clinic Director of Operations and Human Resources when needed.
* Manages staff scheduling and payroll.

PHYSICIANS:

* Facilitates the application process for physician privileges and compliance with Fresenius Medical Care Medical Staff By-Laws.
* Responsible for strong physician relationships and ensures regular and effective communication.
* Participates in Governing Body, an interdisciplinary team for each region including MSWs, Dietitians, MDs, DOs etc. that governs policies.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor’s Degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

**EXPERIENCE AND REQUIRED SKILLS:**

* 4+ years of business operations experience in a healthcare facility.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* Day-to-day work includes desk and personal computer work, facility staff, and physicians.
* Position may require travel between assigned facilities and various locations within the community and/or travel to regional, business unit and corporate meetings may be required.
* The work environment is characteristic of a healthcare facility with air temperature control and moderate noise levels.
* May be exposed to infectious and contagious diseases/materials.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The rate of pay for this position will depend on the successful candidate’s work location and qualifications, including relevant education, work experience, skills, and competencies.

Benefit Overview: This position offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off, parental leave and potential for performance-based bonuses depending on company and individual performance.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Trust & Safety
jobs.description:

Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company's vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate Product Managers to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry from our San Francisco and New York offices.

Trust and Safety is at the core of Lyft's business. Our work ensures that our drivers and riders are part of a trusted and trusting community. Lyft's global expansion and the development of a hybrid platform (with autonomous vehicles driving side by side to drivers) are a unique opportunity to help us redefine how we deliver in our promise of safety. This is a highly cross functional role that will partner with our Growth organization to rethink how we support these partnerships.

---------------------

* Partner directly with engineering, data science, ML, design, and research teams to develop safety solutions uniquely tailored to each of our partners while maintaining a core platform that allows for speed of execution and maintainability.

* Define success metrics and drive data-informed decisions to ensure optimal prioritization

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Hologram**
------------------

Hologram is building the future of IoT connectivity, delivering internet access to millions of connected devices worldwide. We process over 5 billion transactions per month across our global infrastructure. This isn't just another app; it's the invisible backbone powering everything from fleet tracking to smart city infrastructure. We tackle challenges of scale, reliability, and performance that few companies face.

**What Makes a Hologrammer?**
-----------------------------

We look for people with insatiable curiosity and an uncompromising commitment to excellence. Hologrammers are the type who dig deeper when things break, ask 'why' before 'how,' and aren't satisfied until the solution is bulletproof.

**You'll love working here if you:**

**Value tenacious ownership of outcomes:** You own the result, not just your piece of it. When a number is wrong or a deal stalls, you find out why and fix what caused it rather than flagging it to someone else.

**Thrive on building the system, not just running it:** You want to build things that last. You think through the edge cases before they cause problems, automate what would otherwise need watching, and document well enough that the next person can pick it up.

**Relentlessly pursue growth:** You push past where you're comfortable, in what you know and what you're trusted with. You revisit your own decisions, treat good enough as a starting point, and raise the bar without anyone asking.

**Revenue Operations Manager**
------------------------------

### **About This Role:**

Hologram's revenue runs through a stack you'll own: Salesforce, a bespoke CPQ, contract and billing integrations, and the reporting that Sales, Finance, and leadership use to run the company every week. As Revenue Operations Manager, your job is to make that stack a competitive advantage: reps quote and close faster, Finance closes on clean data, and leadership sees pipeline, bookings, and renewals early enough to act.

You'll report to the Director of Finance, partner daily with Sales and Marketing leadership, and run RevOps as a function of one with engineering support. You'll decide what gets built and then build it, with AI agents and automation as first-class tools. You'll set the RevOps roadmap, not inherit one.

### **What You'll Do:**

**Systems and integrations**

* Set the RevOps roadmap for Sales and Finance leadership: what to build, automate, and sunset, with a business case behind each proposal
* Own Salesforce administration, from the data model through releases, and build the validation rules and automated checks that keep the org clean as it scales
* Own the GTM tool stack beyond Salesforce, integrations included
* Own the integrations and automated data feeds between Salesforce, billing, and finance, and the accuracy of the revenue data moving across them
* Design and maintain lead routing and the BDR-to-AE hand-off, from assignment logic through SLAs, including rules of engagement.

**Deal process and commissions**

**About Gather AI**  
Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? At Gather AI, we're not just creating software; we're pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We've developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining "on-time, in full" delivery.  
If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We're leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.  
**About the Team**  
Gather AI's Hardware team designs, builds and supports the hardware behind our platform: autonomous inventory drones and camera systems that mount on customers' material handling equipment (MHE). The team includes hardware engineers and technicians who work out of the Pittsburgh HQ. Hardware designs and builds new product implementations, reviews and repairs RMAs, and performs detailed analysis of field failures while Field Ops runs day-to-day customer site support.  
**About the role**  
Our robots are already working in customer warehouses, and every new deployment depends on the right hardware arriving built, configured and ready. In this role, you'll own the hardware side of that: deployment readiness, field hardware escalations and returns, and accurate documentation of deployment configurations and bill of materials (BOMs) across Hardware programs. This is an ownership role and much of the processes behind it are yours to build collaboratively with Hardware leadership. As our Hardware Deployment & Development Coordinator, you'll be the hardware team's hub between development and field operations: making sure each deployment's hardware is ready on time, owning how we handle field hardware issues and returns, and keeping our bills of materials and fleet configurations accurate across all our hardware programs. You'll report to our Director of Hardware and work closely with engineers, technicians, Field Ops, Purchasing and customer implementation teams.  
**What you'll do**

* Own hardware readiness for each customer deployment: build schedules, kit lists, parts status, shipping and site prerequisites.
* Be on site for installs and go-lives as the hardware liaison lead, then hand off cleanly to Field Ops.
* Own tier-2 hardware escalations: triage, route to the right technician or engineer, and close the loop.
* Own our RMA process: intake, disposition, failure analysis coordination and trend reporting back to engineering and suppliers.
* Own BOM accuracy and configuration management across programs, including revision control and serial/config traceability.
* Build and document the processes behind the work, including the readiness checklist, RMA workflow and configuration control.
* Plan development builds and test assets with engineering and the technicians, and turn field findings into engineering action.
* Coordinate development builds, test assets and technician schedules, and turn field findings into engineering action.
* Give Purchasing a clear demand plan and flag long-lead and single-source risks early.

**What you bring**

* You've owned hardware readiness for deployments, production launches or NPI builds end to end —, covering schedules, kits, parts and handoffs — and kept other teams moving toward the date without direct authority.
* You've owned the record of what hardware is built and implemented: BOMs and revisions, configurations and change control, or RMA processes. Ideally you've build one of these, not just owned it.a BOM or configuration record, an inventory system or an RMA process.
* You can read assembly and part drawings, electrical schematics, and understand critical to quality callouts. drawings and harness pinouts, and you're comfortable getting hands-on to troubleshoot hardware.
* You can take a field escalation from first report to resolution and keep everyone informed along the way.
* You're detail-oriented, agile and adaptable and adapt quickly when plans change.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in warehouse, material handling or forklift environments.
* Robotics or autonomous-vehicle deployment experience.
* Experience working with suppliers or contract manufacturers on ECOs or recurring defects.Experience coordinating with suppliers or contract manufacturers.
* Experience with Document Control, Good Documentation Practices, and Good Manufacturing Practices.

**Location** Pittsburgh, PA (on site) or remote in the US. About one week a month on site in Pittsburgh; when a customer deployment is active, travel to that site takes priority. Eastern time zone is a plus.  
**How we hire** A recruiter conversation, a conversation with the hiring manager, a practical deployment-planning exercise, and a final round with the team. We'll tell you before each step whether AI tools are welcome.

As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

We are looking for a **Marketplace Onboarding Manager** **(or a** **Marketplace Operations Manager** as we like to call it!) to join our Product Team. This individual will report into our Senior Manager, Category Management and will be responsible for the day-to-day operational health of SupplyHouse's third-party marketplace channel. This role ensures that marketplace performance is continuously monitored, supplier onboarding is executed efficiently, and catalog and listing quality standards are upheld. If you are interested in finding and onboarding new marketplace suppliers and building a pipeline of qualified partners, we want to hear from you!

This **remote** position is open to individuals who live in, or are open to relocating to, the following states: *Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.*

This position requires travel to our headquarters in Melville, NY 3 times per year for internal meetings and team building activities. We reimburse reasonable and necessary travel expenses, and you're also welcome to work on-site anytime beyond these visits – our doors are always open.

* Lead technical feed setup and validation for new suppliers—mapping product data, verifying feed accuracy, and resolving data quality issues prior to go-live
* Train new suppliers on SupplyHouse's systems, data standards, and operational requirements, ensuring they are set up for long-term success on the platform
* Serve as the primary point of contact for new suppliers through the onboarding period, troubleshooting issues and maintaining momentum to hit go-live milestones

* Respond to basic marketplace customer inquiries escalated from Customer Service or order fulfillment, and review processed returns to identify trends
* Reconcile discrepancies between freight and non-freight shipping methods and partner with Product Catalog to update item dimensions as needed
* Monitor out-of-stock items and communicate gaps to the Merchandising team; support price update processes to maintain alignment between SupplyHouse and supplier pricing

**Requirements:**

jobs.title: Project Controls & QA/QC Project Manager - EV Charging Programs
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

 **Job Description**

Turner & Townsend is seeking a detail-driven **Project Controls & QA/QC PM** with 5+ years of experience to support a fast-growing EV charging program for a leading autonomous vehicle client. The program develops fleet charging depots with third-party charging partners under a Charging-as-a-Service (CHaaS) model, with an active pipeline across USA, EMEA and APAC.

You will be the quality and control backbone of a regional delivery team. You will own the program's trackers, reporting and workflow discipline, and run first-line quality checks on feasibility reviews, project charters and partner submissions before they reach leadership. This role suits someone who enjoys bringing order to a high-volume pipeline, catches what others miss, and wants to grow toward program management in EV infrastructure.

**Responsibilities**

Quality assurance and quality control

* Run first-line QC on feasibility reviews and project charters
* Verify completeness and consistency: site data, charger details, electrical service etc
* Validate deliverables against client standards; track issues to closure.
* Build, maintain and version-control QC checklists, templates and document standards.
* Track QC metrics and report on trends.

Project controls and reporting

* Own the program pipeline tracker and single source of truth for sites across all stages.
* Produce weekly and monthly program reporting
* Monitor SLA performance; flag aging items and bottlenecks early.
* Maintain intake logs, including ad-hoc sites outside the formal pipeline

Systems and reporting

* Maintain the program's reports and dashboards in Smartsheet (or future platforms).
* Develop standards and short user guides so Regional PMs enter data consistently.
* Act as first point of contact for PM tool questions

Program operations

* Manage project intake screening and keep project records complete.
* Capture meeting decisions and track action items.
* Maintain site tour logs and consolidate PM feedback from site visits.
* Coordinate document control across the client, charging partners and internal teams.

Continuous improvement

* Identify repetitive manual work and seek out automation opportunities.
* Support the Team Lead on process, playbook and tooling improvements
* Provide support to Regional PMs on routine deliverables during peak periods.
* Adhere to SOX control responsibilities where applicable.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, architecture or a related field, OR equivalent experience.
* If you live in/near San Francisco, CA, you should be able to be onsite 3 days a week.
* 5+ years in project controls, QA/QC, project coordination or assistant project management on capital, real estate or infrastructure programs.
* Experience supporting construction of service centers, transportation hubs, or infrastructure-heavy facilities.
* Familiarity with permitting and utility coordination processes.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Google workspace, and project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet or Sitetracker).
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing project needs.
* Comfortable working in both field and office settings, with occasional travel as needed.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage documentation across multiple projects.
* Knowledge of EV systems, charging infrastructure, or fleet operations is beneficial.
* Proven experience reviewing technical documents for completeness and accuracy against standards or checklists.

**Preferred:**

* Exposure to EV charging infrastructure, fleet depots, utility coordination or permitting.
* Experience with multi-party delivery models (developer, partner or owner's rep).
* Lean, Six Sigma or similar process-improvement training.

 **Additional Information**

**The salary range for this full-time role is** **$120K-$130K** **per year.** Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. This range is a reflection of base salary only, not of a total compensation package. Please note Turner & Townsend reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range, depending on candidate’s experience and qualifications.

* ***On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.***

  
Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and https://www.heery.com/

jobs.title: Project Coordinator I: Project Management & Client Support – (CA, AZ & MA)
jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator I: Project Management & Client Support – (CA, AZ, & MA)**

**About iQ Biosciences**

iQ Biosciences (iQ) is a specialized preclinical research partner dedicated to helping drug developers ask the right questions early to generate meaningful data and make confident decisions throughout development. Since 2014, our immunology expertise, coupled with our agility, drive, and collaborative approach, has made us the partner of choice for research organizations of all sizes and across a range of therapeutic areas. iQ offers an integrated, scientist-led model that combines three core capabilities – high-quality cellular products, in vitro bioservices, and custom bioconjugation – and a commitment to being as passionate about its clients' research as they are.

**About the Role**

Reporting to the Senior Project Manager, the Project Coordinator I supports the successful delivery of scientific projects and contributes to inside-sales activities. This entry-level role will work closely with the Senior Project Manager and cross-functional scientific and operational teams to keep projects organized, communications timely, and client records current.

The position is designed for someone who is organized, client-focused, and wants to build a career in biotechnology project management, client services, or inside sales. Responsibilities may shift based on business needs and the employee’s strengths, interests, and demonstrated capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive project planning, execution, tracking, and closeout under the guidance of the Senior Project Manager.
* Track timelines, milestones, client materials, deliverables, action items, and follow-up needs. Surface any process gaps and identify corrective workflow processes.
* Coordinate with scientific, operational, business development, and finance teams to support timely project execution.
* Draft professional client communications and prepare proposals, project documents, and other client-facing materials.
* Coordinate internal and client meetings, including scheduling, agendas, decisions, and action items. Summarize key information in after action-reports and confirm understanding across stakeholders, utilizing background knowledge of scientific needs.
* Own invoicing, documentation review, deliverable tracking, and project closeout.
* Maintain accurate project, client, lead, and opportunity information in CRM and project-tracking systems.
* Follow up on inquiries and proposals, help qualify opportunities, and support existing client relationships.
* Develop project management training materials, tools, processes, and SOPs.
* Have ownership of projects as experience and proficiency grow.
* Provide additional project management, client service, inside sales, or administrative support based on business needs.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in biology, immunology, or a closely related life-science field.
* Interest in progressing in project management, client account support, or inside sales role.
* At least 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing role. Relevant experience may come from biotechnology, a contract research organization, hospitality, restaurants, or another service-oriented environment.
* Strong organization and follow-through with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Confidence interacting with clients and internal stakeholders in a professional and service-oriented manner.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

**Who You Are**

* **Eager to learn:** You are curious, receptive to feedback, and motivated to continually build your scientific and project management knowledge.
* **Passionate about the science:** You enjoy understanding the scientific rationale behind each project and how the work supports the client’s broader goals.
* **Accountable:** You take ownership of your responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and communicate early when something may affect scope, timing, or deliverables.
* **Proactive:** You anticipate next steps, identify potential risks or gaps, and take action before they become larger issues.
* **Organized:** You can manage multiple projects, priorities, timelines, and follow-up items while maintaining attention to detail.
* **Detail-oriented:** You consistently produce accurate, thorough work and carefully review project details, pricing, documentation, and communications before they are finalized.
* **Collaborative:** You work effectively with scientific, operational, business development, and finance teams to keep projects moving.
* **Clear communicator:** You communicate thoughtfully and professionally, adapting the level of detail for clients and internal teams.
* **Adaptable:** You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where project needs, timelines, and priorities may change.

**General Information**

* Full-time, exempt position.
* Candidates **may be based in California, Arizona, or Massachusetts only.** On-site/hybrid in Alameda, CA preferred. Remote work from California, Arizona, or Massachusetts will be considered.
* Relocation assistance: No
* Occasional travel of 10%-15% may be required for conferences, client meetings, or company activities.
* Schedule: Based on location. Must be able to overlap hours to PST operating hours. Occasional night or weekend work may be required.
* Compensation: Range $60,000 to $83,000 annually, based on location/experience.
* Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with employer match after the introductory period, paid holidays, PTO, EAP, life and long-term disability insurance, FSA with employer contribution, and company-provided lunch/snacks.

This job description outlines the position's primary duties and requirements. Additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to support the goals and objectives of the organization.

jobs.title: Project Manager – Lab Equipment & Casework
jobs.description:
Micro-Cap Solutions is conducting a confidential search on behalf of an established architectural millwork and laboratory casework manufacturer seeking an experienced Project Manager – Lab Equipment & Casework to oversee complex laboratory and scientific casework projects from award through installation and closeout.

Our client specializes in custom manufacturing and installation, including laboratory casework, scientific furniture, and specialized equipment. This position requires a strong understanding of commercial construction, technical coordination, and project execution, with particular emphasis on laboratory environments and Division 11/12 scopes.

The Role

The Project Manager will be responsible for the overall execution and financial performance of assigned laboratory casework and equipment projects, overseeing scheduling, budgeting, procurement, subcontractor coordination, and client communication.

This is a hands-on position requiring close collaboration with General Contractors, Architects, Laboratory Planners, Engineering, Production, and Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) trades.

The ideal candidate understands how laboratory casework and equipment integrate with building systems and can proactively identify coordination issues involving utility rough-ins, equipment installation, and project sequencing.

Key Responsibilities

**Project Management & Execution**

* Manage laboratory casework and scientific equipment projects from award through installation and final closeout
* Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, budgets, and delivery expectations
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify cost, scheduling, and execution risks
* Coordinate with subcontractors, suppliers, and internal departments to ensure project requirements are met
* Maintain consistent communication with General Contractors and other project stakeholders
* Manage multiple project priorities while maintaining quality and customer satisfaction

**Laboratory Casework & MEP Coordination**

* Coordinate Division 11/12 laboratory casework and equipment scopes with Architects, Laboratory Planners, General Contractors, and MEP trades
* Review architectural drawings, laboratory equipment plans, and coordination drawings
* Coordinate plumbing, electrical, and HVAC requirements for laboratory benches, fume hoods, and built-in equipment
* Identify conflicts involving utility rough-ins, equipment placement, and installation sequencing before they impact the project
* Coordinate fume hood exhaust systems and emergency safety equipment, including eyewash stations and safety showers
* Review laboratory casework shop drawings and submittals for compliance with project specifications and applicable SEFA standards

**Financial Management & Change Orders**

* Monitor project budgets and financial performance throughout execution
* Prepare and negotiate change orders, including pricing and supporting documentation
* Identify value-engineering opportunities and cost-saving solutions
* Complete monthly Cost-to-Complete reporting
* Coordinate with Finance to maintain accurate project financial reporting and ERP information
* Manage project scopes involving annual billings of $5M or more

**Engineering, Procurement & Installation**

* Review project submittals against architectural plans, specifications, and contractual scope
* Verify material takeoffs and ensure timely procurement of required materials
* Coordinate equipment lead times and material availability with project schedules
* Partner with Engineering, Production, and Field Operations to resolve technical and constructability issues
* Ensure subcontractors, suppliers, and installation teams follow approved drawings, specifications, and schedules
* Proactively address field issues to maintain project momentum

**Qualifications**

* **3–4+ years of hands-on field and/or shop experience** within millwork, laboratory casework, scientific furniture, or another construction trade
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, technical specifications, and construction documents
* Basic working knowledge of plumbing, electrical, and HVAC systems as they relate to laboratory casework and equipment
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to manage competing deadlines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently
* Strong computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel and Outlook
* Familiarity with SEFA standards and laboratory casework systems preferred
* Prior millwork Project Management or Project Engineering experience is a plus
* Experience with laboratory planning, fume hoods, scientific casework, or epoxy resin countertops is highly desirable
* Working knowledge of Innergy ERP is a plus
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management or related trade education preferred
* Familiarity with Lean Construction principles and continuous improvement is beneficial

**EEO Statement**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $1,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

### **WE ARE A FEDERAL IT COMPANY ON A MISSION TO MAKE CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE (CX) THE CENTER OF EVERY GOVERNMENT SOLUTION.**

We know tech, but we love people. NuAxis is home to thinkers and feelers; engineers and artists. We work hard and support each other along the way. Teamwork is more than just a buzzword for us, it’s a state of mind.

### **ROLE SUMMARY**

A hybrid quality assurance and business analysis role on an Agile delivery team modernizing WHD’s legacy .NET applications (Workers Owed Wages, External User Portal, Section 14(c), FLC Online, DirectoryAdmin) to Drupal 10+ on DOL’s PACE containerized AWS platform, and building new public-facing portals for wage determination surveys and online complaint intake. The role owns the path from requirements elicitation to accepted, release-ready functionality, including functional, security, and Section 508 test evidence required for every production release.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Facilitate requirements elicitation with WHD Product Owners, SMEs, and OCIO stakeholders; decompose needs into Jira epics, features, and user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria.
* Document and maintain process flows, use cases, wireframe annotations, and requirements traceability in Jira and Confluence.
* Develop sprint- and release-level test plans, test cases, and test scripts; execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing support.
* Test Drupal Webform-based forms and integrations with Login.gov, WISE/CAPS on Appian, SharePoint, and Kafka, including real-time inline validation, one-time submission rules, bilingual (English/Spanish) content, and audit logging.
* Perform Section 508 / WCAG AA conformance testing using the DHS Trusted Tester methodology and DOL-approved tools (ANDI, NVDA, JAWS, Compliance Sheriff), including keyboard operability and assistive technology compatibility.
* Conduct application security testing in support of DevSecOps and the ATO: validate OWASP Top 10 protections (XSS, CSRF, SQL injection), review scan results, and verify remediation of STIG and SRR findings.
* Support OCIO security test and evaluation activities and assessment teams during system security testing.
* Log, categorize, and trace defects per OCIO categories with full linkage (Roadmap User Story Task Defect); deliver end-to-end defect reports at the close of every test cycle.
* Assemble release-readiness evidence: Section 508, mobile/tablet, security, and functional test reports, with no open in-sprint defects.
* Participate in all Agile/SAFe ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of combined software quality assurance and business analysis experience, including 3+ years in federal Agile/SAFe environments.
* Current DHS Trusted Tester certification (verification of Section 508 knowledge is required for contract personnel).
* Hands-on experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and test cases in Jira and Confluence (Xray, Zephyr, or similar).
* Working knowledge of web application security testing (OWASP Top 10) and NIST SP 800-53 / ATO support activities.
* Experience testing public-facing web portals and forms, including REST API testing with Postman or similar tools.
* Strong written communication and stakeholder facilitation skills.
* U.S. person; must obtain and maintain a favorable NACI / HSPD-12 background investigation.

jobs.description:
**About Assembly Software**

Assembly Software is the team behind Neos, the case management platform purpose-built for personal injury law firms, with embedded intelligence that already knows your cases. We're trusted by 1,100 firms and 15,000 users nationwide, backed by more than 40 years of experience in PI case management. As a growing SaaS company with a passionate team, we're building software that makes cases easier to manage and outcomes better for the firms and clients who rely on it.

When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned-up industry.

**Vision Statement**

Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime.

**Mission Statement**

Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers.

**Core Values**

* We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency + feedback.
* We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth + learning.
* We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions + work respectfully with one another.
* We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative + open-minded.
* We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer + our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service + add value.
* We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
* We Embrace Diversity + Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.

We don't just sell a product and walk away. We stay. We help our clients build better workflows, train their teams, and actually use the platform they're paying for, and that's what makes our retention numbers something to be proud of.

We're looking for a **Customer Success Manager** who thrives on making clients genuinely successful, not just satisfied. In our POD model, the CSM has a clear and powerful mandate: own the customer relationship, drive adoption, renew confidently, and generate the kind of qualified leads that only come from deep customer trust. You're freed from deal forecasting and transactional selling. Your job is to make customers love Assembly, and let that speak for itself.

You'll own a portfolio of law firm accounts from the moment onboarding ends, running the proactive outreach, health reviews, and training that keep clients engaged and adopting new features. When usage dips or a health score slips, you'll catch it early and act before it becomes a renewal problem. And when you spot the kind of expansion or referral signal that only comes from a trusted relationship, you'll route it to the right team as a real, qualified lead, not just a note in passing.

If this sounds like the seat you've been waiting for, we'd love to hear from you.

**When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have questions. Here are a few things we get asked all of the time:**

**1. I'm tired of the daily commute. Where are you located?**  
Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe.

**2. What makes Assembly Software different?**  
Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Backed by Ridge Road Partners since 2017, we combine decades of legal tech expertise with a scrappy, entrepreneurial energy. We move fast, we care about the product, and we have fun doing it. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact.

**3. What's the benefits package like?**  
Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans
* Short and long term disability coverage
* Supplemental insurance options
* 401(k)
* Flexible time off
* Paid parental leave
* An Employee Assistance Program

We invest in our people because we know our results depend on them. When you do great work here, you'll be recognized and rewarded for it.

*Assembly Software provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

About Exdion

Exdion is an AI-driven document intelligence company built for insurance brokers and agencies. Our AI suite helps leading brokerages check policies, compare quotes, build proposals and process endorsements with greater speed and accuracy. Our products integrate with the agency management systems brokers already run, so service teams catch errors earlier, reduce E&O exposure and spend more time with clients. www.exdioninsurance.com

The role

You will own the success of some of Exdion's largest client relationships: major US insurance brokerages, typically representing $1M or more in annual revenue each. These programs roll Exdion's policy checking into commercial and personal lines servicing across large, diverse and geographically distributed client teams. They often include an integration with the client's agency management system, such as Applied Epic.

This is a change leadership role as much as an account role. These programs succeed when account managers and service teams across many offices change how they handle policy checking and renewals, and keep doing so. You will be the person who makes that happen, working side by side with each client's PMO, change management team, technology leads and executive sponsors.

You will be someone who has sat in the servicing seat at a P&C brokerage. You know what a renewal cycle feels like in the last two weeks of the month, and you can speak to service teams as a peer.

Key responsibilitiesOwn the client relationship

* Serve as the single accountable owner of the relationship, from executive sponsors to front-line service teams.
* Build trusted relationships with the client's leadership, PMO, change management team, technology leads and regional or practice leaders.
* Run the governance rhythm: weekly working sessions, monthly steering reviews and quarterly executive business reviews.
* Read and navigate the organizational dynamics that come with large-scale change, including competing priorities, leadership shifts and pockets of resistance.

Drive adoption and change

* Partner with the client's PMO and change management team on the rollout plan, sequencing offices, teams and lines of business.
* Identify, recruit and support client champions, and help them lead change within their own teams.
* Map Exdion's policy checking into the client's commercial and personal lines servicing and renewal workflows, including how results flow into Applied Epic.
* Track adoption and utilization by team, spot lagging groups early and put recovery plans in place.
* Translate client feedback into clear requirements and priorities for Exdion's product and delivery teams.

Training and enablement

* Assess training needs and skill gaps across client roles, offices and experience levels.
* Work with the Exdion team to create training material tailored to the client: guides, job aids, videos, workshop content and FAQs.
* Plan and deliver training programs, workshops, office hours and refresher sessions, both in person and virtually.
* Onboard new client users and teams as the rollout expands, and keep material current as the product evolves.

Work across Exdion

* Partner with the VP of Product, Sales leadership and senior management to deliver on commitments and keep the client roadmap aligned.
* Coordinate with implementation, integration and support teams so that issues are resolved quickly and the client hears one voice.
* Report account health, risks and opportunities to Exdion leadership with clear data and a point of view.

Retention, stickiness and growth

* Own account health, renewal readiness and client satisfaction.
* Define success KPIs jointly with each client, covering adoption, utilization, quality and business outcomes, and report against them on an agreed cadence.
* Identify early risk signals, such as falling usage, sponsor changes, unresolved issues or team pushback, and act on them before they become escalations.
* Be relentlessly proactive: anticipate client needs, bring ideas and solutions before being asked, and never let the client chase Exdion for an answer.
* Demonstrate value with measurable outcomes: errors caught, time saved, renewal quality and E&O risk reduction.
* Embed Exdion deeply into the client's standard operating procedures so that it becomes how the work gets done.

Must-have qualifications

* Hands-on experience at a P&C insurance brokerage or agency in a servicing capacity, such as account manager, CSR, account executive or service team leader.
* Deep expertise in commercial lines policy management and the renewal cycle: marketing, quoting, binding, policy issuance, policy checking, endorsements, certificates and stewardship.
* Working knowledge of common agency management systems, with strong preference for Applied Epic. Familiarity with others, such as AMS360, Sagitta or BenefitPoint, is welcome.
* A track record of driving change in collaboration with client or internal teams across a large, diverse and distributed workforce.
* Experience working with PMOs, change management teams and technology leads on multi-office or enterprise-wide rollouts.
* Proven ability to navigate leadership dynamics, build consensus and influence without authority, from the C-suite to the service desk.
* Experience assessing training needs and gaps, building training material, and delivering training programs and workshops.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the presence to lead an executive review and the patience to coach a new user.
* Willingness to travel to client offices as the program requires.

Preferred qualifications

* Experience at a top-100 brokerage, or at a brokerage that has grown through acquisition and runs varied servicing models across offices.
* Prior customer success, implementation or account management experience at an InsurTech or SaaS vendor serving brokers.
* Familiarity with policy checking, E&O risk controls and service center or outsourced servicing models.

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft Cloud and end user computing investments.

Deploying, managing, and cost-optimizing Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Intune is technically complex without a purpose-built management layer on top. Nerdio is that layer. We automate what Microsoft’s native tooling leaves manual, so enterprises and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) can run cloud desktops at scale with lower cost, less operational effort, and less migration risk.

Founded in 2016, Nerdio is used by more than 15,000 organizations in over 50 countries and was named Microsoft’s 2024 Americas Partner of the Year. Our vision is to be the control plane that makes Microsoft cloud workspaces simpler, more efficient, and cost-effective at scale. Nerdio is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Field Enablement to be the connective tissue between Product, Marketing, and our direct and partner sales organizations. jobs.title: Customer Care Supervisor
jobs.description:
**Overview**

**Job description:**

Premier Sperm Bank is a physician-led, rapidly growing organization helping individuals and couples across the U.S. and around the world start or expand their families. Our customer care sales team is the front door to that experience, and we’re hiring a Customer Care Supervisor to help lead it.

We’re looking for a hungry, hands-on sales leader to help run our client sales team day to day. This is not a desk-and-dashboard management job. You’ll carry your own leads, take your own calls, and set the pace for the team through your own results, while also training, coaching, and holding the team to a high standard. We’re growing fast, things are still being built, and we want someone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and sees this as an opportunity to grow with us.

Our clients are thoughtful, informed, and often navigating an emotional journey; they expect clarity, confidence, and direction, and rely on us to help them move forward with their decision at the right time.

**What You’ll Do**

*Sell and set the standard*

* Carry a personal book of leads and own the client journey from initial donor inquiry through vial purchase and repeat purchase
* Handle a high volume of inbound and outbound calls daily, and lead by example on the phone
* Engage with intended parents via phone, chat, text, and email and convert inbound interest into sales
* Keep accurate records of client interactions, transactions, and follow-up workflows in the company's databases
* Guide clients through donor selection, extended profiles, vial selection, and logistics (storage, shipping, and/or pick-up)
* Drive revenue through multi-vial purchasing strategies and future family planning

*Lead the team day to day*

* Supervise, train, and mentor customer care team, keeping them aligned with company goals, standards, and performance targets
* Help the team prioritize their leads, focusing effort on the opportunities most likely to convert
* Coach through live call support, call review, and regular one-on-ones; celebrate wins and address gaps quickly
* Monitor pipeline health, oversee the team's dedication to client follow-ups, and conversion metrics and step in where the numbers show a need
* Onboard new hires and help build or update the training materials, scripts, and playbooks.

*Own the client experience*

* Ensure a seamless, high-quality experience at every touchpoint by maintaining service excellence
* Ensure client inquiries and complaints are escalated to proper management for timely and satisfactory resolution
* Develop and implement customer service protocols that optimize the customer journey
* Partner with clinical and operational leadership to make sure clients receive correct, updated, and concise information

*Build the machine*

* Act as the liaison between the sales team and senior leadership, ensuring alignment of objectives and resources
* Identify and help implement process improvements that raise sales efficiency and client satisfaction
* Partner with senior leadership to develop and implement departmental policies and procedures that support organizational goals and compliance requirements
* Optimize our HubSpot workflows, reporting, and CRM discipline
* Help facilitate B2B outreach and referral relationships (e.g., fertility clinics, providers, and partner organizations)

* A proven sales professional who has also led, trained, or informally mentored other salespeople (formal management experience is a plus, but a track record of lifting a team’s results counts)
* Self-driven: you’re energized by growing, and you don’t wait for a process to exist before you improve things
* Comfortable on the phone at high volume and unafraid of any call, including the difficult ones
* Skilled at reading a pipeline and teaching others to prioritize it
* Able to balance empathy with decisiveness with clients and with your team
* Confident in a high-value sales environment ($4K–$10K is the typical client journey)
* Highly organized, with strong follow-up habits and attention to detail
* Calm and professional when handling escalations and unhappy clients
* Comfortable giving direct, constructive feedback and holding people accountable, while earning their trust
* Discreet and welcoming to all family types, including single parents by choice, LGBTQ+ individuals and couples, and heterosexual couples facing infertility
* Motivated by both team success and measurable performance (conversion, revenue, and client outcomes)

**Preferred Experience**

We value candidates who bring strong sales and client advisory experience, particularly in high-touch or healthcare-related environments. Relevant backgrounds may include:

* 5+ years of client services or call center sales experience, ideally including time as a team lead, supervisor, or senior advisor
* Healthcare, wellness, or medical sales (including but not limited to OB/GYN or women’s health)
* Patient-facing roles involving complex decision-making (e.g., care coordinators, client advisors, or navigators)
* Experience in fertility, sperm banks, or egg banks is very helpful but not required
* We place a high value on intellectual curiosity, the ability to quickly learn clinical concepts, and the ability to communicate them clearly to clients.
* Experience building or refining sales processes in a growing or start-up environment
* Candidates should be comfortable learning and discussing basic fertility concepts (e.g., ovulation timing, insemination), though prior expertise is not required.

**Who Thrives in this Role**

* Players who coach: people who’d rather get in the trenches with the team than direct from the sidelines
* Builders who see a gap and fill it without being asked
* Natural leaders who are collaborative but decisive and can guide both clients and teammates to a clear next step

jobs.title: Customer Care Agent
jobs.description:
**Overview**

**Job description:**

Premier Sperm Bank is a physician-led, rapidly growing organization serving individuals and couples across the United States and internationally. We combine clinical rigor with a modern, high-touch client experience to support people on their path to building a family.

We are seeking a Customer Care Agent who can build trust, provide clear guidance, and consistently convert client interest into purchase decisions. This is a sales position within a collaborative, team-based environment. It is also a high-volume, phone-forward role: our team spends much of their day in live conversations with clients.

Our clients are thoughtful, informed, and often navigating an emotional journey; they expect clarity, confidence, and direction, and rely on us to help them move forward with their decision at the right time.

* Own the client journey from initial donor inquiry through vial purchase, and repeat purchase
* Engage with intended parents via phone, chat, text, and email and convert inbound interest into sales

* High-volume of high-intent inbound leads
* A role with direct impact on revenue and growth
* Collaborative, team-based sales model
* Meaningful work helping individuals and couples build families
* Opportunity to help build a modern, data-driven sales organization

**Benefits:**

* Eligible for bonuses based on individual and team performance
* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home
