jobs.title: Senior Oncology Account Manager, Manhattan
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

The Senior Oncology Account Manager is responsible for the direct promotion of Revolution Medicines’ products and for building strong professional relationships with key customers and stakeholders, including private practices, medical group practices, hospitals/academic medical centers, and office ancillary staff involved in the care of cancer patients. The Senior Oncology Account Manager will act as both a clinical and business leader who exemplifies the values of Revolution Medicines by providing approved disease and product information, as well as resources, to key decision-makers and stakeholders within their assigned territory. This position reports directly to the Area Business Director.

Primary responsibilities of the Sr. Oncology Account Manager are summarized below.

* Effectively markets Revolution Medicines’ product portfolio in the designated territory.
* Responsible for exceeding assigned performance goals for the territory by effectively positioning the benefits and use of RevMed’s products for appropriate patients.
* Exhibits effective time management by directing efforts towards engagements that drive brand value and prioritizing activities that positively impact patients.
* Partners with key internal stakeholders to remove barriers to care, ensuring every eligible patient receives timely access to RevMed products.
* Demonstrates the ability to flex between virtual and in-person engagements and develop business plan considering account communication preferences.
* Ability to analyze key market data points and action insights into effective business planning and implements these plans by engaging key targets via call optimization and resource utilization.
* Develops deep, sustained customer relationships across assigned accounts and proactively challenges customers through innovative, value-driven solutions.
* Represent RevMed’s brands in a professional, compliant, ethical, and effective manner.
* Exhibits a thorough understanding of disease states, Revolution Medicine’s products, and relevant competitor offerings and effectively articulates value across all communication channels (i.e. digital, live, etc.).
* Possess comprehensive understanding of the reimbursement process and fulfillment pathways for oral oncolytics.
* Demonstrates highly effective territory management and superior selling competencies.
* Illustrates the ability to creatively gain “access” to customers in the modern landscape.
* Drives team effectiveness and accomplishment of shared goals by leveraging and sharing expertise and information.
* Effective management of territory resources and budget.
* Complies with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Revolution Medicines staff.
* Visibly embodies corporate Core Values while cultivating an energized team culture focused on patient impact.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* MA/MS/BA/BS degree and 12-15+ years of biopharma industry experience.
* 8-12+ years of prior experience in oncology product sales.
* Proven track record of product launch success in the oncology therapeutic space.
* Oral Oncolytic product launch experience.
* Experience launching oncology products with companion diagnostics.
* Proven performer in highly competitive marketplaces.
* Proven performer in solo-representative selling environments.
* Demonstrated success operating in small/midsize biotechnology environments.
* Ability to meet territorial travel requirements.
* Ability to travel to meetings/training/programs, as necessary.
* Proven effectiveness in highly collaborative & cross-functional working environments.
* Valid driver's license.
* Must permanently reside in the territory for which they are accountable.
* ~50% travel required.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in the NSCLC oncology space.
* Advanced degree (MBA, PharmD, PhD).
* Strong organization, planning, project management, technical and analytical skills.
* Other relevant experience (e.g., sales operations, market research, market access, etc.)
* Ability to work independently to execute strategic and tactical plans under tight timelines.
* Delivers compelling presentations to individuals and groups, adapting messaging to maximize audience engagement.
* Highly proficient in Microsoft suite including Powerpoint, Excel, Word.

The range displayed on each job posting is intended to be the base pay salary range for an individual working onsite in Redwood City and will be adjusted for the local market a candidate is based in. Our base pay salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Individual base pay salary is determined by multiple factors, including job-related skills, experience, market dynamics, and relevant education or training.

Please note that base pay salary range is one part of the overall total rewards program at RevMed, which includes competitive cash compensation, robust equity awards, strong benefits, and significant learning and development opportunities.

jobs.title: Product Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  
Comfrt is one of the fastest-growing direct-to-consumer brands, dedicated to blending mental wellness, inclusivity, and elevated comfort into every piece we create. Our mission goes beyond clothing — we strive to build a community where everyone feels supported and seen.  
  
**About the Job:**  
The Product Operations Specialist keeps every SKU defined the same way across Comfrt's systems, so orders, inventory, and reporting all refer to the same product. This role sits within Operations and owns SKU mapping verification, the connections between systems that carry product data, and the upkeep and troubleshooting that keep those connections working.  
  
**Responsibilities:**

  

**SKU Mapping**

* Confirm and verify that every SKU is correctly mapped across the ERP, e-commerce, warehouse, and marketplace systems so each product has one consistent identifier and attribute set.
* Maintain SKU mapping tables and cross-reference files, and resolve duplicate, retired, bundled, or variant SKUs. Make sure this is being done across all business systems and data warehouses.
* Validate new product and variant setups against the mapping standards before they go live.
* Work with the Master Data Analyst to apply golden-record rules and naming conventions to product data.

**Cross-System Connections**

* Assist in maintain the data connections between systems that exchange product, pricing, and inventory data.
* Configure field mappings, sync rules, and transformations in integration tools, and document each connection.
* Support Ecommerce Team on any needs during product launch set up.
* Partner with BSA Team on new integrations and changes to existing ones.
* Test changes in a sandbox before they reach production and confirm that data arrives correctly downstream.

**Upkeep and Monitoring**

* Monitor sync jobs, integration logs, and error queues on a set schedule.
* Run routine data checks for missing attributes, mismatched SKUs, and stale records, and correct them before they affect orders.
* Keep integration documentation, mapping logic, and runbooks current.

**Troubleshooting**

* Investigate and resolve product data issues, failed syncs, and mismatched inventory or order records.
* Find root causes, not just symptoms, and log recurring issues so they can be fixed at the source.
* Escalate platform or infrastructure problems to BSA or Data Engineering with clear reproduction steps and impact.
* Communicate status and resolution timelines to Operations leadership and affected teams.

**Process and Reporting**

* Build and maintain reports on SKU data health, sync reliability, and open issues.
* Document standard operating procedures for SKU setup, mapping changes, and integration support.
* Recommend process improvements to the Senior Manager of Operations based on recurring issues and data trends.

**Qualifications:**

* 2-4 years of experience in product operations, data operations, supply chain operations, or a similar role that involves product data.
* Hands-on experience maintaining SKU or item master data in an ERP or inventory system, such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or Fulfil.
* Practical experience with integration or ETL tools such as Celigo &Boomi including field mapping and troubleshooting sync failures.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and data cleanup.
* Working knowledge of e-commerce platforms such as Shopify and their product catalog structure.
* Ability to read logs, trace data through connected systems, and identify root causes.
* Clear written communication for SOPs, runbooks, and issue updates.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage several open issues without close supervision.

**Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity with MDM concepts such as golden records, entity matching, and data governance.
* Experience with SQL or basic scripting for data checks.
* Experience with a Product Information Management (PIM) tool.
* Bachelor's degree in operations, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.

**What Success Looks Like in One Year:**

* SKU mapping accuracy at or above 99% across connected systems, measured by monthly audits.
* Sync failures resolved within 1 business day, with recurring failures traced to a permanent fix.
* Zero unmapped SKUs at product launch.
* Documentation for every active integration and SOP kept current on a quarterly review cycle.

**Why Join Comfrt?**

* Be part of a purpose-driven company that's shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
* Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
* Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
* Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

*Comfort is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.*

​​Individuals with a history of justice system involvement are strongly encouraged to apply*.*

This position requires approximately 50% of work hours within in-custody jail settings and access to sensitive and protected data and therefore requires but is not limited to completion of Live Scan fingerprinting, and Tuberculosis testing prior to hire and ability *to* abide by all in-custody rules as it relates to attire, personal belongings, materials, conduct, and use of sensitive data.

**PROJECT MANAGER**

**Build at the Highest level | FORMA Construction**

**Come build the projects you want to be known for.**

FORMA was founded with a clear Mission: to be **the most respected partner for highly complex and detailed residential projects.**

You will lead sophisticated custom residential projects involving exceptional architecture, demanding details, discerning clients, and some of the best architects, designers, and craftspeople in the industry.

We are looking for experienced construction leaders who love the challenge of complicated projects, take pride in being exceptionally prepared, want real responsibility, and are motivated by working alongside other highly capable people.

If you are competitive about your craft, if you like being trusted with difficult things, and if being surrounded by excellent people makes you want to raise your own game, **you should keep reading.**

FORMA has spent years building some of California's most distinctive residences.

Our current portfolio includes projects with some of the most respected architecture and design firms in the industry, including **Feldman Architecture, Butler Armsden Architects, Studio Vara, Marmol Radziner, Ingrao Design, EYRC Architects and KOVAC Architecture.**

Our work ranges from complex structural transformations in San Francisco to major ground-up residences throughout the Bay Area—and now into Southern California.

**FORMA is a team. We are not a family.**

But high standards do **not** mean a cutthroat environment. Great teams invest in their players.

And like a great team, We coach. We practice. We teach. We leverage experience and provide tools and resources. We believe that when you give great people, great tools and training, you allow talented people opportunities to stretch themselves to become even better.

Understand where the project is financially today and, more importantly, where it is going.

Identify exposure early rather than explaining overruns later.

**Planning and schedule**

Recognize potential delays early and create a plan to address them.

Run effective OAC meetings.

Know the outstanding design issues.

Know the decisions that need to be made.

Know who owes what to whom and when.

Your client, architect, Superintendent and internal team should leave meetings with greater clarity because you were in the room.

**Client and design-team partnership**

**Contract and risk management**

Recognize contractual and project risk early and take action to protect the client, the project and FORMA.

Raise the level of the people around you.

**Organization Description**

The Miss Major Alexander L. Lee TGIJP Black Trans Cultural Center is a team of transgender, gender-variant and intersex people, inside and outside of prisons, jails, detention centers, and other locked facilities creating a united family in the struggle for survival and freedom. We work in collaboration with others to forge a culture of resistance and resilience to strengthen us for the fight against human rights abuses, imprisonment, police violence, racism, poverty, and societal pressures. We seek to create a world rooted in self-determination, freedom of expression, and gender justice.

**Position Description**

TGIJP’s Client Services Coordinators are the first to greet our clients, staff, partners, Board Members, and other community members when they come into our office. First impressions are everything when it comes to telegraphing safety, security, empowerment, trauma-informed care, and an abolitionist mindset to all we meet. You’re expected to know how to work with dozens of different kinds of people effectively, to know how to appropriately prioritize and execute administrative and operational tasks, and to be able to maintain a level of professionalism, pleasant demeanor, and grounded approach to the work.

* Supervise clients, staff, and the general public who may be waiting in lobby or front desk areas.
* Maintain safety protocol, and serve on the TGIJP Safety Committee.

***3. Administrative Support***

* Organize and manage the front desk, documents, and relevant paperwork while removing any clutter.
* Answer front desk phone calls while maintaining HIPAA compliance.

* Promote upcoming TGIJP events and client satisfaction surveys.
* Attend training and meetings as scheduled and assigned.
* Submit monthly progress reports to the Program Director.
* Other duties as assigned by the Program Director.

***4. Cleaning***

* Maintain cleanliness across the building, also including the front door, restrooms, and outside area around the building.
* Restock the waiting room fridge, supply closet, restrooms, and snack trays as needed.
* Refill the water cooler in the waiting room as needed.
* Take out the trash in every room in the office each day, and take out the trash that has collected in the waste bins every Wednesday night at midnight.
* Vacuum, sweep, dust, and mop the office as directed.
* Safely utilize cleaning chemicals.
* Inform leadership when repairs are needed.

***5. Driving***

**About the role**
------------------

The IT Project Manager owns the technical delivery of client implementations, from data onboarding and integration through validation and go-live. You will develop detailed project plans, define scope, set milestones, allocate resources, and manage schedules to ensure timely delivery across varying project types ranging from 1 week to 6 months.  
  
You will keep plans current in Smartsheet and Jira and give executive leadership a transparent view of status, risk, and decisions needed.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Project delivery**

* In collaboration with the Sales team complete the sales hand-off to implementation ensuring scope and deliverables are understood prior to drafting plans and securing technical resources.
* Plan and run 4–8 concurrent client implementations, from kickoff through go-live and hand-off to Client Success.
* Build and maintain project plans, timelines, and dependencies in Smartsheet; keep Jira epics and tasks in sync with the plan.
* Lead client meetings, business reviews, and requirement discussions ensuring alignment of the client expectations are understood and can be met by our technical and business subject matter experts.
* Lead technical workstreams: data intake and file specifications, SFTP/API integrations, data quality validation, environment setup, and user access.
* Manage scope, change requests, and the RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, decisions); escalate early with options, not just problems.

**Stakeholder and client management**

* Run internal and client status meetings, with agendas, notes, and action items sent within 24 hours.
* Serve as the day-to-day technical contact for client IT, data, and security teams.
* Prepare concise status reports and dashboards for executive leadership.

**Compliance and quality**

* Ensure every project follows HIPAA, HITRUST, and Prealize data-handling policies, including the minimum-necessary standard for PHI.
* Coordinate security questionnaires, BAAs, and data-sharing approvals with Security and Legal.

**Process improvement**

* Refine implementation templates, playbooks, and Smartsheet–Jira workflows.
* Capture lessons learned at close-out and feed them into the next project.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years managing IT or software implementation projects, with at least 2 years in healthcare, health tech, or payer/provider settings.
* Working knowledge of healthcare data: claims, eligibility, EHR/clinical data, and common file formats and transfer methods (flat files, SFTP, APIs).
* Hands-on experience with HIPAA-regulated data and security reviews.
* Proficiency in Smartsheet (or MS Project) and Jira; comfort with both waterfall and agile delivery.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including presenting status and trade-offs to executives and clients.
* Proven ability to run several projects at once without dropping details.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* PMP certification preferred; PMI-ACP or Certified ScrumMaster a plus.
* Experience implementing predictive analytics, population health, or risk-stratification products.
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (AWS, Snowflake, or similar) and SQL basics for data validation.
* Experience with Smartsheet–Jira integrations and building Smartsheet dashboards.
* Background supporting multi-tenant or channel-partner programs (e.g., PEOs, TPAs).

Prealize Health is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

new_jobs.description:
**About Gather AI**  
Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? At Gather AI, we're not just creating software; we're pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We've developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining "on-time, in full" delivery.  
If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We're leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.  
**About the Team**  
Gather AI's Hardware team designs, builds and supports the hardware behind our platform: autonomous inventory drones and camera systems that mount on customers' material handling equipment (MHE). The team includes hardware engineers and technicians who work out of the Pittsburgh HQ. Hardware designs and builds new product implementations, reviews and repairs RMAs, and performs detailed analysis of field failures while Field Ops runs day-to-day customer site support.  
**About the role**  
Our robots are already working in customer warehouses, and every new deployment depends on the right hardware arriving built, configured and ready. In this role, you'll own the hardware side of that: deployment readiness, field hardware escalations and returns, and accurate documentation of deployment configurations and bill of materials (BOMs) across Hardware programs. This is an ownership role and much of the processes behind it are yours to build collaboratively with Hardware leadership. As our Hardware Deployment & Development Coordinator, you'll be the hardware team's hub between development and field operations: making sure each deployment's hardware is ready on time, owning how we handle field hardware issues and returns, and keeping our bills of materials and fleet configurations accurate across all our hardware programs. You'll report to our Director of Hardware and work closely with engineers, technicians, Field Ops, Purchasing and customer implementation teams.  
**What you'll do**

* Own hardware readiness for each customer deployment: build schedules, kit lists, parts status, shipping and site prerequisites.
* Be on site for installs and go-lives as the hardware liaison lead, then hand off cleanly to Field Ops.
* Own tier-2 hardware escalations: triage, route to the right technician or engineer, and close the loop.
* Own our RMA process: intake, disposition, failure analysis coordination and trend reporting back to engineering and suppliers.
* Own BOM accuracy and configuration management across programs, including revision control and serial/config traceability.
* Build and document the processes behind the work, including the readiness checklist, RMA workflow and configuration control.
* Plan development builds and test assets with engineering and the technicians, and turn field findings into engineering action.
* Coordinate development builds, test assets and technician schedules, and turn field findings into engineering action.
* Give Purchasing a clear demand plan and flag long-lead and single-source risks early.

**What you bring**

* You've owned hardware readiness for deployments, production launches or NPI builds end to end —, covering schedules, kits, parts and handoffs — and kept other teams moving toward the date without direct authority.
* You've owned the record of what hardware is built and implemented: BOMs and revisions, configurations and change control, or RMA processes. Ideally you've build one of these, not just owned it.a BOM or configuration record, an inventory system or an RMA process.
* You can read assembly and part drawings, electrical schematics, and understand critical to quality callouts. drawings and harness pinouts, and you're comfortable getting hands-on to troubleshoot hardware.
* You can take a field escalation from first report to resolution and keep everyone informed along the way.
* You're detail-oriented, agile and adaptable and adapt quickly when plans change.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in warehouse, material handling or forklift environments.
* Robotics or autonomous-vehicle deployment experience.
* Experience working with suppliers or contract manufacturers on ECOs or recurring defects.Experience coordinating with suppliers or contract manufacturers.
* Experience with Document Control, Good Documentation Practices, and Good Manufacturing Practices.

**Location** Pittsburgh, PA (on site) or remote in the US. About one week a month on site in Pittsburgh; when a customer deployment is active, travel to that site takes priority. Eastern time zone is a plus.  
**How we hire** A recruiter conversation, a conversation with the hiring manager, a practical deployment-planning exercise, and a final round with the team. We'll tell you before each step whether AI tools are welcome.

* Have ownership of projects as experience and proficiency grow.

**Required Qualifications**

This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.
  
Kadiak, LLC a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking a Senior Project Manager to support Kadiak and our government customer. The position is remote. This position requires the candidate to be able to obtain a Public Trust.
  
Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.
  
We are seeking a highly analytical and execution-oriented Senior Project Manager to support a large-scale Federal Health IT program modernizing the Electronic Health Record (EHR) for the Indian Health Service (IHS).
  
The Project Manager will lead complex, cross-functional project activities across a highly matrixed and multi-vendor environment. This role requires someone who can operate effectively in ambiguity, bring structure to complex work, and translate broad program requirements into actionable project plans and measurable outcomes.
  
The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, naturally curious, and comfortable diving deep into data to understand what is happening across a program. The candidate must be Proficient user of Microsoft Project. You will be expected to connect information from multiple sources, validate schedule and status information, identify root causes and emerging risks, and translate information into Work Breakdown Structures, Detailed Schedules and Integrated Master Schedule updates.
  
This is an opportunity for a hands-on project manager who enjoys bringing order to complexity and improving how work gets done.

* Lead large-scale, complex, cross-functional projects and workstreams within a Health IT/EHR modernization environment.
* Develop and manage comprehensive, interdependent project plans from concept through completion.
* Translate broad program requirements, objectives, and stakeholder inputs into actionable project plans, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Drive execution in environments where scope, requirements, and work ownership may be ambiguous or evolving.
* Establish clarity around objectives, responsibilities, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* Monitor project performance and proactively identify schedule, resource, dependency, and execution risks.

**Schedule Management & Analysis:**  

* Develop, maintain, and analyze complex project schedules using Microsoft Project.

* Conduct schedule analysis to identify bottlenecks, emerging risks, missed dependencies, and potential impacts to key milestones.
* Partner with stakeholders to develop mitigation strategies and drive corrective actions.
* Maintain schedule integrity and ensure updates are timely, accurate, and supported by appropriate evidence.

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership:**  

* Align cross-functional stakeholders and leadership around project objectives, priorities, dependencies, and decisions.
* Drive teams from undefined tasks toward clarity by facilitating discussions, identifying gaps, and establishing actionable paths forward.
* Work effectively across a highly matrixed, client-facing, multi-vendor environment.
* Work with stakeholders and facilitate decision-making even when formal authority is limited.
* Communicate complex information, data, risks, and dependencies in a concise manner that enables leadership to make informed decisions.
* Build strong relationships with government clients, program leadership, vendors, technical teams, and functional stakeholders.

**Process Improvement & PMO Governance:**  

* Bring structure, discipline, and repeatability to projects operating in environments with low project management process maturity.
* Identify opportunities to improve project execution, reporting, governance, and decision-making processes.
* Develop and implement repeatable and scalable project management practices, tools, templates, and governance processes.
* Serve as a champion for sound project management practices while adapting processes to the needs of the program and client.
* Continuously evaluate how work is being performed and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, predictability, and accountability.

**Analysis & Problem Solving:**  

* Dive deeply into project data and stakeholder information to understand root causes and distinguish symptoms from underlying issues.
* Connect disparate information across functional areas to identify trends, dependencies, and potential impacts.
* Apply analytical thinking and curiosity when evaluating new or incomplete information.
* Proactively identify risks and bottlenecks before they become significant delivery issues.

new_jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Company:** Black Digital  
**Location:** Remote  
**Position Type:** Part-Time, Independent Contractor (Contract-to-Hire)  
**Compensation:** $12–$16 USD per hour, based on experience  
**Hours:** 20–25 hours per week, with availability during agreed U.S. Eastern business hours

**About Black Digital**

Black Digital is a full-service digital marketing and creative agency specializing in branding, digital marketing, creative campaigns, website development, and strategic communications.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day administrative and operational needs of our agency.

The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and capable of independently following through on assignments. This role will work closely with agency leadership, internal team members, and external accounting partners to keep operations organized and efficient.

**We're looking for someone who takes ownership of getting things done, not just tracking what's pending.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operations & Administrative Support**

* Maintain internal workflows, recurring tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups in Monday.com.
* Coordinate calendars, meetings, approvals, and administrative requests.
* Maintain organized company files, internal documents, forms, trackers, and SOPs.
* Track software subscriptions, vendor contracts, renewals, and administrative deadlines.

**HR & Contractor Administration**

* Coordinate employee and contractor onboarding and offboarding.
* Collect and organize contractor agreements, employment documents, and other required records.
* Prepare standard agreements using approved templates and coordinate electronic signatures.
* Maintain accurate, confidential personnel and contractor documentation.

**Finance Administration**

* Monitor employee and contractor time tracking compliance in Clockify.
* Collect invoices, receipts, and other documentation for the outsourced accounting team.
* Track outstanding invoices, payment statuses, and accounts receivable follow-ups.
* Coordinate administrative finance requests with external accounting partners.

**Executive & Business Support**

* Assist agency leadership with scheduling, meeting preparation, approvals, and follow-ups.
* Track outstanding decisions and ensure administrative tasks are completed.
* Support recruitment coordination, interview scheduling, and candidate communications.
* As capacity allows, maintain CRM records, organize prospect information, and assist with standard proposal materials.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows using automation and AI tools.

**Additional Responsibilities:** Perform other duties and support related projects as needed, consistent with the scope of the role, agreed working hours, and business priorities.

**Required Qualifications**

* **3+ years of experience** in operations coordination, administrative operations, executive assistance, or a similar role.
* **Proficiency with Google Workspace, Monday.com, and Slack is required.**
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and experience managing competing priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, solve problems, and follow through without constant supervision.
* Experience handling confidential employee, financial, and contractual information.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and administrative processes.
* Availability for scheduled internal meetings and agreed working hours overlapping U.S. Eastern Time.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting a U.S.-based company, marketing agency, or professional services business.
* Familiarity with Clockify, electronic signature platforms, and CRM systems.
* Experience using ChatGPT or other AI platforms to streamline administrative workflows.
* Basic understanding of finance administration, invoicing, and contractor management.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Internal operational tasks are completed accurately and on time.
* Administrative workflows are organized and consistently maintained.
* Outstanding requests and approvals are proactively followed up on.
* Employee and contractor documentation is accurate, complete, and confidential.
* Finance administration and documentation flow smoothly between internal teams and external accounting partners.
* Agency leadership spends less time managing routine administrative work.

**How to Apply**

To be considered, please email the following to **hello@blackdigitalgroup.com**:

* Your current resume.

All requested materials are required for consideration.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid practical assessment.

Pay: $12.00 - $16.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 25.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Care Coordinator for Population Health - remote position
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Patient Care Coordinator to serve on our Population Health team to be the friendly, organized voice patients hear when they call in for scheduling, referrals, and follow-up. If you love helping people, thrive on staying organized, and want the flexibility of working from home while still being part of a patient care team, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a non-clinical role — no medical procedures, no license or certification required. That said, if you're a Certified Medical Assistant (CMA, RMA, or CCMA) looking for a lower-stress, work-from-home alternative, this role was built with you in mind.

The ideal candidate will possess strong organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and a thorough understanding of medical administrative processes. You will be responsible for managing patient interactions and ensuring seamless communication within the healthcare team. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to high-quality patient care while supporting operational efficiency in a dynamic medical environment.

**What You'll Do**

* Be the first friendly voice patients, clients and vendors hear — answering calls, scheduling and confirming appointments, and helping with portal messages and emails.
* Schedule, confirm, and coordinate patient appointments using specialized patient management software and Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems.
* Process referrals from start to finish: submitting requests, securing insurance authorizations, and tracking status with specialists' offices.
* Assist patients with insurance verification, billing inquiries, and understanding health coverage options.
* Protect patient privacy and handle sensitive information with care, every time.
* Support medical staff by preparing necessary documentation, managing medical administrative tasks, and ensuring smooth population health operations.
* Stay informed about relevant health regulation policies to ensure compliance across all administrative activities.

**What We're Looking For**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* No license or certification required — Medical Assistant certification (CMA, RMA, or CCMA) is a plus.
* Prior experience working in a medical office or healthcare setting is required.
* Strong customer service skills with the ability to handle sensitive situations professionally and empathetically.
* Comfortable learning new software and working with an EHR system.

If you're organized, personable, and ready to bring your patient service skills to a remote role, we want to meet you!

**Apply today and join our team in making a meaningful difference in our patients' healthcare experiences!**

Pay: $21.00 - $24.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Tester (QA / Security / 508) + Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
### **WE ARE A FEDERAL IT COMPANY ON A MISSION TO MAKE CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE (CX) THE CENTER OF EVERY GOVERNMENT SOLUTION.**

### **TECHNOLOGY IS OUR PASSION. PEOPLE ARE OUR PURPOSE.**

We know tech, but we love people. NuAxis is home to thinkers and feelers; engineers and artists. We work hard and support each other along the way. Teamwork is more than just a buzzword for us, it’s a state of mind.

We believe happy employees do amazing work, so join our team NOW! We are currently seeking a talented and motivated **Tester (QA / Security / 508) + Business Analyst** for a Full-Time position.

### **ROLE SUMMARY**

A hybrid quality assurance and business analysis role on an Agile delivery team modernizing WHD’s legacy .NET applications (Workers Owed Wages, External User Portal, Section 14(c), FLC Online, DirectoryAdmin) to Drupal 10+ on DOL’s PACE containerized AWS platform, and building new public-facing portals for wage determination surveys and online complaint intake. The role owns the path from requirements elicitation to accepted, release-ready functionality, including functional, security, and Section 508 test evidence required for every production release.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Facilitate requirements elicitation with WHD Product Owners, SMEs, and OCIO stakeholders; decompose needs into Jira epics, features, and user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria.
* Document and maintain process flows, use cases, wireframe annotations, and requirements traceability in Jira and Confluence.
* Develop sprint- and release-level test plans, test cases, and test scripts; execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing support.
* Test Drupal Webform-based forms and integrations with Login.gov, WISE/CAPS on Appian, SharePoint, and Kafka, including real-time inline validation, one-time submission rules, bilingual (English/Spanish) content, and audit logging.
* Perform Section 508 / WCAG AA conformance testing using the DHS Trusted Tester methodology and DOL-approved tools (ANDI, NVDA, JAWS, Compliance Sheriff), including keyboard operability and assistive technology compatibility.
* Conduct application security testing in support of DevSecOps and the ATO: validate OWASP Top 10 protections (XSS, CSRF, SQL injection), review scan results, and verify remediation of STIG and SRR findings.
* Support OCIO security test and evaluation activities and assessment teams during system security testing.
* Log, categorize, and trace defects per OCIO categories with full linkage (Roadmap User Story Task Defect); deliver end-to-end defect reports at the close of every test cycle.
* Assemble release-readiness evidence: Section 508, mobile/tablet, security, and functional test reports, with no open in-sprint defects.
* Participate in all Agile/SAFe ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of combined software quality assurance and business analysis experience, including 3+ years in federal Agile/SAFe environments.
* Current DHS Trusted Tester certification (verification of Section 508 knowledge is required for contract personnel).
* Hands-on experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and test cases in Jira and Confluence (Xray, Zephyr, or similar).
* Working knowledge of web application security testing (OWASP Top 10) and NIST SP 800-53 / ATO support activities.
* Experience testing public-facing web portals and forms, including REST API testing with Postman or similar tools.
* Strong written communication and stakeholder facilitation skills.
* U.S. person; must obtain and maintain a favorable NACI / HSPD-12 background investigation.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience testing Drupal 10+ applications, Appian integrations, or Login.gov authentication flows.
* Exposure to test automation (Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium).
* Certifications such as CBAP/CCBA, ISTQB, CSM/CSPO, SAFe, or CompTIA Security+.
* Prior support of DOL or another federal enforcement or regulatory agency.
* Experience using DOL-approved AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to accelerate requirements and test case development.

**DOES THIS OPPORTUNITY SOUND LIKE A FIT FOR YOU? IF SO, JOIN OUR TALENT COMMUNITY AND CLICK TO APPLY NOW!!**

**OUR PROFILE:**

We are an IT company with a unique mission—to make people the center of every federal IT solution. Our technologists have always gone the extra mile to help our federal clients succeed. And over the years, we saw a growing disconnect in how federal IT initiatives were built and managed. Time after time, programs failed because the focus was on the tools and products and not the people using them. **LEARN MORE****.**

NuAxis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation. **LEARN MORE** about our Benefits and Culture!

#NAI #DICE

Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. * Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and deliver personalized solutions that support repeat business and long-term account retention.
* Establish consistent service standards and communication workflows across all B2B customer touchpoints.

Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

The Senior Oncology Account Manager is responsible for the direct promotion of Revolution Medicines’ products and for building strong professional relationships with key customers and stakeholders, including private practices, medical group practices, hospitals/academic medical centers, and office ancillary staff involved in the care of cancer patients. The Senior Oncology Account Manager will act as both a clinical and business leader who exemplifies the values of Revolution Medicines by providing approved disease and product information, as well as resources, to key decision-makers and stakeholders within their assigned territory. This position reports directly to the Area Business Director.

Primary responsibilities of the Sr. Oncology Account Manager are summarized below.

* Effectively markets Revolution Medicines’ product portfolio in the designated territory.
* Responsible for exceeding assigned performance goals for the territory by effectively positioning the benefits and use of RevMed’s products for appropriate patients.
* Exhibits effective time management by directing efforts towards engagements that drive brand value and prioritizing activities that positively impact patients.
* Partners with key internal stakeholders to remove barriers to care, ensuring every eligible patient receives timely access to RevMed products.
* Demonstrates the ability to flex between virtual and in-person engagements and develop business plan considering account communication preferences.
* Ability to analyze key market data points and action insights into effective business planning and implements these plans by engaging key targets via call optimization and resource utilization.
* Develops deep, sustained customer relationships across assigned accounts and proactively challenges customers through innovative, value-driven solutions.
* Represent RevMed’s brands in a professional, compliant, ethical, and effective manner.
* Exhibits a thorough understanding of disease states, Revolution Medicine’s products, and relevant competitor offerings and effectively articulates value across all communication channels (i.e. digital, live, etc.).
* Possess comprehensive understanding of the reimbursement process and fulfillment pathways for oral oncolytics.
* Demonstrates highly effective territory management and superior selling competencies.
* Illustrates the ability to creatively gain “access” to customers in the modern landscape.
* Drives team effectiveness and accomplishment of shared goals by leveraging and sharing expertise and information.
* Effective management of territory resources and budget.
* Complies with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Revolution Medicines staff.
* Visibly embodies corporate Core Values while cultivating an energized team culture focused on patient impact.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* MA/MS/BA/BS degree and 12-15+ years of biopharma industry experience.
* 8-12+ years of prior experience in oncology product sales.
* Proven track record of product launch success in the oncology therapeutic space.
* Oral Oncolytic product launch experience.
* Experience launching oncology products with companion diagnostics.
* Proven performer in highly competitive marketplaces.
* Proven performer in solo-representative selling environments.
* Demonstrated success operating in small/midsize biotechnology environments.
* Ability to meet territorial travel requirements.
* Ability to travel to meetings/training/programs, as necessary.
* Proven effectiveness in highly collaborative & cross-functional working environments.
* Valid driver's license.
* Must permanently reside in the territory for which they are accountable.
* ~50% travel required.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in the NSCLC oncology space.
* Advanced degree (MBA, PharmD, PhD).
* Strong organization, planning, project management, technical and analytical skills.
* Other relevant experience (e.g., sales operations, market research, market access, etc.)
* Ability to work independently to execute strategic and tactical plans under tight timelines.
* Delivers compelling presentations to individuals and groups, adapting messaging to maximize audience engagement.
* Highly proficient in Microsoft suite including Powerpoint, Excel, Word.

new_jobs.title: Office Manager/Administrative Assistant
new_jobs.description:
Theris delivers telepsychiatry and behavioral health care to senior-living communities across several states. We're looking for an organized, dependable Office Administrator to support our Executive team and keep the business running behind the scenes. The role starts part-time and could become full-time.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
**Bookkeeping & Finance:**

* Enter and code vendor bills and expenses in Bill.com / QuickBooks Online.
* Track receipts, staff reimbursements and payment follow-ups.
* Keep financial records and supporting documents organized.
* Pull and distribute AR/AP aging reports, balance sheets, income statements.

**Recruiting & Human Resources:**

* Post jobs, screen applicants and schedule interviews.
* Prepare and track offer letters, agreements and e-signatures.
* Maintain employee and contractor files and HR records.
* Assist in preparing and submitting payroll.
* Respond to employee inquiries.

**Onboarding & Credentialing:**

* Coordinate new-hire onboarding paperwork and checklists.
* Assemble provider credentialing and payer-enrollment packets (CAQH, NPI, Medicare) and track their status.
* Keep licenses, certifications and expiration dates current.

**Business Administration & Vendor Relations:**

* Help with business registrations and state filings for new entities.
* Follow up with vendors, insurers and service providers.
* Manage correspondence and keep shared files organized and confidential.

**Requirements:**

* 1–2+ years of office or administrative experience, ideally in a healthcare or behavioral health setting.
* 1–2+ years of HR/People Operations experience, ideally in a healthcare or behavioral health setting.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office/Outlook and AI tools like Claude
* Indeed, BoldSign, and ADP experience preferred.
* QuickBooks, Acumatica, Navan, and Bill.com experience preferred.
* Strong organization, follow-through and attention to detail.
* Discretion with confidential HR, financial and health information.
* Credentialing experience is a plus.

**Job Type:** Part-time (20hrs per week), could become full-time

Pay: $17.00 - $19.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote
